When forking conversations in the extension, only one of the tool calls run in parallel was previously kept, and trailing messages kept by automatic compaction were often lost, leaving responses without context; message loss has now been eliminated. When Claude does not finish starting in time, the extension now automatically attempts to start Claude once more before showing an error, preventing lost messages. The interface no longer mistakenly opens the sign-in screen when a request is blocked for its region or network. Even when telemetry collection is turned off, the `ultrathink` command now reliably raises effort for its turn and displays its rainbow animation.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
[VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network
[VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off

title.zh-TW: VS Code 面板字體隨設定縮放，檔案連結改開於獨立編輯群組
title.en: VS Code Panel Fonts Scale with Settings and File Links Open in a Separate Editor Group

body.zh-TW: 在編輯器側邊欄微調閱讀視圖與字級大小時，整體的視覺排版決定了查閱程式碼的舒適感。當你在設定中調大 `chat.fontSize` 時，Claude 面板中的附件標籤、功能選單、提示橫幅與對話方塊現在會同步放大，不再縮在角落顯得過小。在對話分頁中點擊檔案連結時，檔案會自動在另一個獨立編輯器群組中開啟，不再粗暴覆蓋掉當前的聊天對話畫面。帳號面板中方案名稱第二個單字先前誤顯示為全小寫的字型問題，也已經重新修正為正確大小寫。
body.en: When fine-tuning the reading view and font size in the editor sidebar, overall visual layout determines the comfort of reviewing code. When `chat.fontSize` is raised in settings, attachment chips, menus, banners, and dialogs in the Claude panel now scale up simultaneously instead of staying small in the corner. When clicking a file link in a chat tab, the file now opens in another separate editor group instead of abruptly replacing the current chat screen. In the Account panel, the typographical issue where the second word of a plan name was mistakenly displayed in lowercase has also been corrected to the proper casing.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word
[VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group
[VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段新增連結卡片，改進管理介面與機密覆寫防護
title.en: Cloud Sessions Add Link Cards, Improve Admin Interface and Secret Overwrite Protection

body.zh-TW: 在雲端環境中與遠端伺服器互動時，彈出的外部連結與組織設定需要嚴謹的防護與清晰的視窗。當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器請求開啟網頁時，雲端工作階段會主動彈出連結卡片，讓你能自由選擇開啟或拒絕，不再讓請求在後台石沉大海。管理員設定中的機構環境對話方塊改為精簡版面，每個區段以橫列展開，未儲存的輸入在關閉前會主動跳出確認提示。若為已有網路機密的主機新增機密，表單會直接拒絕並指明現有機密，防止意外覆寫。新增排程任務時也會主動帶入機構管理員選定的預設環境，不再強制套用官方預設環境。
body.en: When interacting with remote servers in cloud environments, popup external links and organizational settings require rigorous protection and clear presentation. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server asks to open a webpage, cloud sessions now proactively display a link card so you can freely open or decline the link instead of letting the request go unseen in the background. The organization environment dialog in admin settings now uses a compact layout where each section opens from a row, and unsaved input prompts for confirmation before closing. If you add a network secret for a host that already has one, the form directly refuses and points to the existing secret to prevent accidental overwrites. Newly scheduled tasks also automatically populate with the default environment selected by the organization administrator instead of enforcing the official hosted default.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
[Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing
[Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret
[Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default

title.zh-TW: Slack 跨頻道畫布可接續編輯，參與方式設定更名
title.en: Slack Cross-Channel Canvases Allow Continued Edits, Participation Setting Renamed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 跨組織討論或跨頻道共用畫布時，你可能遇過回覆沒人接、Claude 拒絕編輯的狀況。以前 Claude 在頻道自己建立的 Canvas 畫布，另分享至其他頻道或私訊後，就會拒絕在原頻道編輯或追加內容；現在已恢復支援。在兩家公司皆啟用 Claude 的 Slack Connect 討論串中，未特別標註的回覆也不再因轉發至另一家公司的應用程式而漏接。雲端排程的即時清單現在能直接更新當次發出的頂層訊息，避免進度卡在未完成狀態。頻道 Configure 設定頁與 Claude Tag 管理設定中的自動回應開關，都改為「Claude 參與方式」選單。
body.en: When collaborating across organizations or sharing canvases across channels in Slack, you may have encountered unanswered replies or Claude refusing to edit. Previously, once a canvas Claude created in a channel was shared to another channel or a direct message, it refused to edit or append content from that channel; this support has now been restored. In Slack Connect threads where both organizations have enabled Claude, untagged replies no longer go unanswered when forwarded to the other organization's app. The live checklist for cloud scheduled tasks can now directly update top-level messages posted during that run, preventing progress from staying half-done. On a channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings, the Respond automatically switch has been changed to a "How Claude participates" menu.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援 MCP 表單填寫，密鑰管理與路徑顯示最佳化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Support MCP Form Completion, Secret Management and Path Display Refined

body.zh-TW: 當你透過瀏覽器切換雲端工作階段處理專案，各種互動提示與環境權限有了明確回饋。現在當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器提出表單請求，介面會跳出卡片讓你填寫或拒絕，不再無預警直接取消。切回雲端或 Remote Control 遠端控制工作階段時，若訊息還在同步更新，畫面會顯示「Catching up…」。企業版成員能在個人雲端環境新增或刪除網路密鑰，不再限制只能檢視。雲端工作階段的 Files 檔案面板搜尋，修好了 Claude 切換目錄後把資料夾顯示成 ../.. 路徑的問題，改為顯示自專案根目錄起算的路徑。變更面板的省略說明也收納成分支名稱旁的徽章。
body.en: When switching between cloud sessions in a browser to work on projects, interactive prompts and environment permissions now offer clearer feedback. Now, when an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server requests a form, a card pops up in the interface for you to fill in or decline instead of the request being canceled without warning. When switching back to a cloud or Remote Control session while messages are still updating, the screen displays "Catching up…". Enterprise members can now add and delete network secrets in their personal cloud environments, rather than being restricted to view-only access. In a cloud session's Files pane search, a bug where folders appeared as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory has been fixed, and paths now show from the project root. The note explaining what the Changes pane leaves out has also been moved into a badge beside the branch name.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root

title.zh-TW: VSCode 面板支援閘道登入，思考彩虹特效與介面控制項修復
title.en: VSCode Panel Supports Gateway Sign-In, Thinking Rainbow Effect and UI Controls Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 側邊欄與 Claude 協同撰寫程式碼時，登入內部服務與微調思考強度有了更完整的介面支援。現在聊天面板可直接登入企業的 Claude apps 閘道器，無須另外開啟終端機。在對話輸入 `ultrathink`，會讓當回合採用 `xhigh` 極高思考力度，並在聊天輸入框呈現彩虹效果。模型設定帶有 `[1m]` 標記時，Effort 思考力度滑桿、Ultracode 開關與模型名稱也都恢復顯示。設定檔出錯時，已儲存的 `/btw` 提問紀錄不會再被意外清除。若先前已指定手動審核修改，重新載入編輯器後也不會誤跳回自動模式。
body.en: When collaborating on code with Claude in the VSCode sidebar, signing in to internal services and fine-tuning thinking effort now have more complete interface support. The chat panel can now sign in directly to an enterprise Claude apps gateway without opening a separate terminal. Entering `ultrathink` in a conversation runs that turn at `xhigh` effort and displays a rainbow effect in the chat box. When model settings carry the `[1m]` tag, the Effort slider, Ultracode switch, and model name are restored. When a configuration file contains errors, saved `/btw` question history will no longer be wiped accidentally. If manual approval of edits was previously specified, reloading the editor will no longer mistakenly revert to Auto mode.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查改採結構化卡片，分析頁新增嚴重度統計圖表
title.en: Code Review Adopts Structured Cards, Analytics Page Adds Severity Charts

body.zh-TW: 當你提交程式碼請 Claude 協助把關專案品質，產出的審查摘要與分析統計現在一目了然。從桌面版或網頁的 Code 分頁發起 `/code-review` 時，雲端與 `claude remote-control` 遠端控制工作階段會直接顯示結構化的審查結果卡片，取代純文字清單。分析頁面的嚴重程度卡片會顯示所選期間的問題總數、每日依嚴重程度堆疊的圖表，以及各級數量。執行 `/ultrareview`、雲端工作階段或雲端代理找不到 GitHub 遠端關聯時，訊息會指引你到 https://github.com/new 建立儲存庫；其中 `/ultrareview` 也不再推薦會被 `gh` 拒絕的指令。
body.en: When submitting code for Claude to review project quality, the resulting review summaries and analytical statistics are now immediately clear. Starting `/code-review` from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web now displays a structured findings card in cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions instead of a plain-text list. The findings-by-severity card on the analytics page shows the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and counts for each severity level. When `/ultrareview`, a cloud session, or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote, the message guides you to create a repository at https://github.com/new; in addition, `/ultrareview` no longer recommends a command that `gh` rejects.

items.original:
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Bash 工具完整保留別名與函式，背景命令退出不再殘留
title.en: Bash Tool Retains Aliases and Functions, Background Commands No Longer Linger on Exit

body.zh-TW: 當你透過終端機交由 Claude 執行腳本，自訂 Shell（執行指令的環境）的相容性有了修正。macOS 或 Linux 上，Claude Code 因憑證遭拒或雲端工作階段歸檔而自行退出時，不再留下仍執行中的命令。Bash 工具不再弄亂或遺失含換行的別名，但不含 Git Bash；減號開頭的函式名稱也已修好。匯出 `SHELLOPTS` 的腳本不再執行第一句就停擺。Windows 的 Git Bash 若在 rc 啟動設定檔同時設定 errexit 與 pipefail，且只定義 winpty 別名或沒有別名，也不再遺失別名與函式。PowerShell 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）的指令以型別轉換、`param`、`using` 或屬性開頭時，也能依結束代碼 2 阻擋執行。
body.en: When having Claude run scripts through the terminal, compatibility with a custom shell (an environment for running commands) has been improved. On macOS or Linux, when Claude Code exits on its own because credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived, it no longer leaves running commands behind. The Bash tool no longer garbles or loses aliases containing line breaks—except in Git Bash—and functions whose names start with a dash are now fixed. Scripts that export `SHELLOPTS` no longer stall right after their first command. In Windows Git Bash, when an rc startup file sets both errexit and pipefail while defining only winpty aliases or none at all, aliases and functions are no longer lost. When commands in PowerShell hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) start with a type cast, `param`, `using`, or an attribute, they also properly block execution on exit code 2.

items.original:
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined

title.zh-TW: 自動模式權限規則防意外覆寫，中斷狀態與伺服器判定修復
title.en: Auto Mode Permission Rules Prevent Accidental Overwrites, Interruption Status and Server Verdicts Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式下讓 Claude 連續執行任務時，權限清單與中斷原因不該讓你摸不著頭緒。受管理的 `autoMode.allow` 允許清單未含 `"$defaults"` 時，不再因主應用程式的 `--settings`、首次在 `/permissions` 加規則或 `/auto-mode-setup`，而加回內建例外；排程任務提示的內建規則也不會因此被移除。雲端工作階段與排程任務若因伺服器未回傳安全判定、由自動模式停止該回合，會確實標記失敗。背景代理仍在執行時，`claude -p` 文字輸出也會交代自動模式停止回合的原因。由主應用程式啟動、經代理伺服器或 LLM 大型語言模型閘道器連線且關閉實驗性測試功能時，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 不再被忽略。
body.en: When having Claude run tasks continuously in auto mode, permission lists and reasons for interruptions should never leave you guessing. When a managed `autoMode.allow` list omits "$defaults", built-in exceptions are no longer reintroduced by a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`; nor is the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts removed because of this. Cloud sessions and scheduled tasks are now properly marked as failed when auto mode stops a turn because the server returned no safety verdict. While a background agent is still running, `claude -p` text output also explains why auto mode stopped a turn. In sessions started by a host application through a proxy or an LLM (large language model) gateway with experimental features turned off, the `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` environment variable is no longer ignored.

items.original:
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts

title.zh-TW: 憑證錯誤提示列出具體解法，保留私有 CA 所需的交叉憑證
title.en: Certificate Errors Detail Actionable Fixes, Retaining Cross-Certificates for Private CAs

body.zh-TW: 當工具在企業內網或受管網路發送請求，遇到連線驗證失敗時不再只丟出一行模糊代碼。⟦跟海關查驗護照上的簽證戳章一樣，如果發現缺少中介審核章，系統會直接指出漏蓋了哪一關，而不是冷冷關閉閘門。⟧現在遇到 SSL 憑證錯誤，終端機會直接分析可能原因，例如伺服器遺漏了中介憑證，並附上具體的修正指引。針對需要內部私有憑證的架構，可啟用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP`，保留系統中循環互簽的交叉憑證。另外，當伺服器回傳的壓縮資料中途截斷或損毀時，網路請求也不會再無限期卡死。
body.en: When tools send requests across an enterprise intranet or managed network, connection verification failures no longer throw a vague line of code. ⟦Just like customs inspecting visa stamps in a passport, if an intermediate verification stamp is missing, the system points out exactly which checkpoint was skipped instead of coldly shutting the gate.⟧ Now when an SSL certificate error occurs, the terminal directly analyzes likely causes, such as a server omitting an intermediate certificate, and provides specific remediation instructions. For architectures requiring internal private certificates, you can enable the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` environment variable to retain cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop. In addition, network requests will no longer hang indefinitely if compressed data returned by a server is cut off or corrupted midway.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each

title.zh-TW: 閘道器支援群組共用預算，階層政策與 Bedrock 防護標籤上線
title.en: Gateway Supports Pooled Group Budgets, Layered Policies and Bedrock Guardrail Tagging Released

body.zh-TW: 管理團隊花費與權限時，Claude apps 閘道器有了新選項。花費限制管理 API 的 `pooled_budget` 可設群組每月共用預算，各人仍有個別上限。`managed.policy_mode: layered` 套用所有相符政策，上方覆蓋下方。Bedrock 上游的 `guardrail.input_tagging` 加上提示詞攻擊篩選標籤；`all_messages_and_system` 也替系統提示詞加標籤。請求內每個模型都會檢查 `availableModels`、`deniedModels`、`models`；被封鎖時回傳 400 錯誤並指出對應欄位。強制使用閘道器時，終端機的 `claude auth login` 會顯示其登入入口。Team／Enterprise 從 Anthropic API 取得的受管理設定免確認套用；儲存副本驗證失敗就拒用。
body.en: When managing team spend and permissions, the Claude apps gateway has new options. The `pooled_budget` field on the spend limits admin API can set a monthly shared budget for a group on top of each member's individual limit. Setting `managed.policy_mode: layered` applies all matching policies, merging each over the ones listed below it. On Bedrock upstreams, `guardrail.input_tagging` adds prompt attack filter tags; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt. Every model named in a request is checked against `availableModels`, `deniedModels`, and `models`; if blocked, a 400 error is returned naming the relevant field. When a gateway is required, running `claude auth login` in a terminal shows the gateway sign-in prompt. Managed settings fetched from the Anthropic API for Team and Enterprise accounts apply without confirmation, and any stored copy that fails verification is rejected.

items.original:
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused

title.zh-TW: Opus 4.8 快速模式排定退場，三個模型別名修復自動備援
title.en: Opus 4.8 Fast Mode Slated for Deprecation, Three Model Aliases Restore Fallback

body.zh-TW: 當你在多個雲端平台切換不同版本的 Claude 模型，版本遷移與容錯機制有了具體指引。Opus 4.8 快速模式自 2026 年 10 月 30 日起棄用，將於 11 月 30 日移除；移除後的快速模式請求會報錯，不會回退標準版，需遷移至 Opus 5.5 才能保有加速。在 Vertex AI 與 Amazon Bedrock 上，`sonnet`、`opus`、`haiku` 這三個模型別名，若最新版尚未向帳號或區域開放，會切換至相容舊版提供備援，不再於工作階段中途報錯。若用 `/model <id>` 輸入此版本未辨識的型號，也會主動跳出警告，提醒自動壓縮將預設採用 200K 的上下文視窗容量，也就是可容納的對話量。
body.en: When switching between different Claude model versions across multiple cloud platforms, version migration and fault tolerance now have clear guidance. Fast mode for Opus 4.8 has been deprecated as of October 30, 2026, and will be removed on November 30, 2026; once removed, fast mode requests will return an error rather than falling back to standard Opus 4.8, requiring migration to Opus 5.5 to maintain speedups. On Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock, the `sonnet`, `opus`, and `haiku` model aliases now switch to a compatible older version to provide fallback if the newest release is not yet available to your account or region, rather than failing mid-session. Entering an unrecognized model with `/model <id>` now triggers a warning that auto-compact will assume a 200K context window (the conversation volume it can hold).

items.original:
Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window

title.zh-TW: 子代理可設定預設運算力度，支援關閉深度思考關鍵字
title.en: Subagents Support Default Effort Settings, Deep Thinking Keyword Can Be Disabled

body.zh-TW: 當你指派背景子代理分頭調查程式庫，任務的思考深度與模型繼承現在能精細掌控。如果團隊不想觸發額外的高強度推論，可透過環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` 直接停用 `ultrathink` 關鍵字。針對後台衍生出的子代理（處理專案分支任務的助手），只有在其他來源都未指定運算力度時，才會使用 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT`，取代預設繼承主工作階段力度的行為。繼承了上層子代理專屬模型的助手，在被背景通知或新訊息喚醒後，也能持續鎖定指定模型，不會意外跳回主對話模型。
body.en: When dispatching background subagents (helpers that handle branching project tasks) to investigate a codebase, thinking depth and model inheritance can now be finely controlled. If a team prefers not to trigger extra high-intensity reasoning, the `ultrathink` keyword can be disabled directly via the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` environment variable. For subagents spawned in the background, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` is used only when no other source specifies an effort level, replacing the default behavior of inheriting the main session's effort. Helpers that inherit a parent subagent's dedicated model will also stay locked to that assigned model after being awakened by a background notification or new message, rather than unexpectedly reverting to the main conversation model.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器與外掛環境修復，改善 SDK 與產物規則載入
title.en: Fixes for self-hosted runners and plugin environments, with improved SDK and Artifact rule loading

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行環境或撰寫外掛整合時，跨機器狀態與規則顯示不再莫名出錯。自架執行器的工作階段換機後，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器開關狀態不再遺失；按下停止並替換程序後，也不再答覆工作中傳入的舊訊息。外掛的憑證環境變數設為 `1` 等開關值時，`headersHelper` 腳本收到的 `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` 與伺服器網址不再損毀。SDK（軟體開發工具包）的 `register_repo_root` 請求，在 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` 下能載入工作目錄外的 `CLAUDE.md`。產物工具不再把 `self` 自身層級的資料庫存取規則顯示為問號；拒絕會移除這些規則的重新發布時，也會引用這些規則。
body.en: When hosting your own execution environments or writing plugin integrations, cross-machine state and rule displays no longer encounter unexplained errors. After a self-hosted runner session moves to a new machine, the on/off switch state of an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server is no longer lost. After pressing Stop and replacing the process, it also no longer answers old messages sent while Claude was working. When a plugin credential environment variable is set to a switch value such as `1`, the `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL received by `headersHelper` scripts are no longer corrupted. With `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`, the SDK (software development kit) `register_repo_root` request can now load `CLAUDE.md` from outside the working directory. The Artifact tool no longer displays artifact database access rules at the `self` level as question marks, and now quotes those rules back when refusing a republish that would drop them.

items.original:
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine

title.zh-TW: 提示詞輸入清理不可見字元，介面提示與問卷送出機制修正
title.en: Invisible character cleaning in prompt input, with fixes for interface hints and survey submissions

body.zh-TW: 日常在命令列輸入提問與檢視提示時，多處影響打字節奏的介面細節得到了改善。以前從網頁複製文字若夾帶不可見字元，常需連按兩次 Enter 才能送出；現在普通提問第一次按下就會清除這些字元並發送，指令仍保留審查確認步驟。語音輸入提示不再於單一工作階段內耗盡三次顯示額度，未綁定按住說話的熱鍵時，也不再出現空白鍵帽。在窄視窗終端機初次啟動時，安全說明與終端機設定說明都不再漏字。若對話尚在儲存時執行過 `/clear` 清除或 `/resume` 接續指令，還原對話時也能恢復原本的任務計畫。企業問卷輸入 `1` 或 `0` 後，不再因短暫停頓就送出，必須按 Enter 才會確認。
body.en: When entering prompts and viewing hints in daily command-line use, multiple interface details that affect typing rhythm have been improved. Previously, copying text from web pages that contained invisible characters often required pressing Enter twice to send. Plain prompts now clean these characters and send on the first Enter press, while commands still retain the review confirmation step. The voice input hint no longer uses up its quota of three showings in a single session, and an empty keycap no longer appears when push-to-talk is unbound. During first-run startup in narrow terminal windows, security notes and terminal setup explanations no longer drop words. If `/clear` or `/resume` was run while a conversation was still being saved, resuming the conversation now also restores the original task plan. After typing `1` or `0` in the Enterprise survey, answers are no longer submitted due to a short pause, and now require pressing Enter to confirm.

items.original:
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter

title.zh-TW: 受限工作階段不再上傳目錄外檔案，比對與搜尋效能改善
title.en: Restricted sessions no longer upload files outside directories, with diff and search performance improvements

body.zh-TW: 當你在大型專案中比對程式碼變更或搜尋檔案，檔案上傳範圍與回應速度更為可靠。⟦恰似廠區門禁嚴格核對出入清單，即使持有特殊通行證，非指定作業區的機密文件一律禁止攜出大門。⟧以往在 `--restricted` 受限工作階段中，即使工作目錄外的檔案有 Read 讀取允許規則涵蓋，仍不該被上傳；現在已修好這項上傳限制。在大型儲存庫輸入 `/diff` 查看差異時，每次重新整理通常少執行一個掃描整個儲存庫的 Git 命令，並在 Git 反應變慢時自動拉開重新整理間隔。針對 Windows 使用者，Grep 與 Glob 搜尋工具在觸發逾時停止時，也不會再因搜尋行程未順利結束而無止境卡住畫面。
body.en: When comparing code changes or searching files across large projects, file upload scope and responsiveness are now more reliable. ⟦A factory security checkpoint strictly checks the entry and exit list: even with a special pass, confidential documents outside designated work areas are strictly barred from being carried out the gate.⟧ Previously in `--restricted` sessions, files outside working directories were not supposed to be uploaded even when covered by a Read allow rule. This upload restriction has now been fixed. When entering `/diff` in large repositories to inspect changes, each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository Git command, and refresh intervals are automatically spaced out when Git responds slowly. For Windows users, Grep and Glob search tools no longer freeze the screen indefinitely when a search process is killed at timeout but fails to exit cleanly.

items.original:
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

title.zh-TW: 代理人指揮中心標記未讀結果，切換後端工作階段保留草稿
title.en: Agent command center marks unread results, and switching backend sessions preserves drafts

body.zh-TW: 平時如果習慣讓多個助理分頭調查專案，終端機現在能讓你清楚掌握每位幫手的最新進度。執行 `codex agents --no-daemon` 就能進入常駐的代理人指揮中心，指揮中心與終端機工作階段（session，正在進行中的對話作業）選取器現在都會主動標記出未讀的執行結果。⟦猶如總機櫃台的分機信箱，信件送達時格子會亮起提示燈，即使轉身前往另一張辦公桌交涉，手中寫到一半的便箋也不會遺失。⟧當你在工作階段選取器中切換不同的已連線後端時，輸入框中還沒送出的草稿會完整保留下來，不會因為更換後端就遭到清空。
body.en: If you regularly have several assistants investigate different parts of a project, the terminal now makes it easier to keep track of each helper’s latest progress. Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to enter the persistent agent command center. Both the command center and the terminal session picker (for ongoing conversations) now mark unread results. ⟦Like extension mailboxes at a switchboard desk, a compartment lights up when mail arrives, and even if you turn to another desk to discuss something, the note you are halfway through writing stays with you.⟧ When you switch between connected backends in the session picker, any unsent draft in the input box stays intact instead of being cleared.

items.original:
Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框即時預覽附加圖片，逐字稿路徑支援點擊開啟
title.en: Preview attached images in the terminal input box and click transcript paths to open them

body.zh-TW: 在終端機請模型排查版面外觀或分析架構圖時，最怕挑錯要送出的圖檔。現在只要使用支援的終端機，在輸入框撰寫內容時就能直接預覽附加的本機圖片。⟦彷彿在公文夾附上拍立得縮圖，夾上檔案的當下就能先瞄一眼畫面確認無誤，事後查閱歸檔清單時也能隨手按壓標籤快速調閱原圖。⟧而在對話逐字稿（transcript，記錄完整互動內容的文字檔）中，顯示的本機圖片路徑現在也支援點擊，輕點路徑就能直接開啟剛剛檢視過的圖片。
body.en: When asking a model in the terminal to troubleshoot a layout or analyze an architecture diagram, choosing the wrong image to send is a particular concern. On supported terminals, you can now preview attached local images directly while composing in the input box. ⟦Picture attaching a Polaroid thumbnail to a document folder: you can glance at the image as soon as you attach the file to check that it is right, then press its label while reviewing the archive list later to quickly retrieve the original image.⟧ Local image paths shown in the conversation transcript (a text file recording the full interaction) are now clickable too. Click a path to open the image you just viewed.

items.original: Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).

title.zh-TW: 登入選單支援 Vertex AI 設定精靈，切換模型提供者仍可查閱舊紀錄
title.en: Sign-in menu supports a Vertex AI setup wizard, and old chats remain accessible after switching providers

body.zh-TW: 需要連線到不同雲端平台調用模型時，設定登入與管理既有紀錄往往讓人傷腦筋。在「以其他方式登入（Sign in another way）」選單中，現在新增了 API 金鑰與雲端提供者選項。只要啟用 `gcp_setup_wizard` 設定項，就能透過引導精靈以應用程式預設憑證（ADC，Google Cloud 用來自動驗證身分的機制）或憑證檔，快速串接 Google Cloud Vertex AI。⟦如同聘請不同事務所的顧問，櫃台提供制式表單幫你快速登記授權，而先前與上一家顧問往來的會議備忘錄依舊留在手邊，就算無法直接續約也能抄錄結論另開新專案。⟧切換模型提供者後，先前儲存的聊天紀錄依然會留在清單中。如果舊對話無法直接繼續執行，你也可以隨時閱讀歷史逐字稿，並把重點整理成可編輯的提示詞，在全新聊天中直接接續工作。
body.en: When connecting to different cloud platforms to use models, setting up sign-in and managing existing records can be a headache. The “Sign in another way” menu now includes API key and cloud provider options. Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to quickly connect to Google Cloud Vertex AI through a guided wizard using Application Default Credentials (Google Cloud’s mechanism for automatically authenticating your identity) or a credential file. ⟦Think of hiring consultants from different firms: the front desk supplies standard forms to quickly register your authorization, while meeting notes from your previous consultants remain at hand, so even if you cannot renew the engagement directly, you can copy the conclusions into a new project.⟧ After you switch model providers, previously saved chats remain in the list. If an old conversation cannot resume directly, you can still read its historical transcript and turn the key points into an editable prompt to continue working in a new chat.

items.original:
Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).

title.zh-TW: 審批提示下可展開修補細節，清螢幕保留紀錄且退格不跳指令模式
title.en: Expand patch details during approval, clear the screen while keeping history, and backspace without entering command mode

body.zh-TW:
在終端機審查程式碼修改並輸入回應時，細節檢視與打字體驗迎來了一批順手改進。

跳出審批提示（approval prompt）時，你現在能直接在對話逐字稿中展開修補程式細節，不必先退出提示才能看清改動。

在終端機整理畫面時，按下 `Ctrl+L` 會清空螢幕顯示內容，先前的對話訊息依然隨時能透過 `Ctrl+T` 叫出查閱。

在輸入框退格刪除文字時，就算露出開頭的驚嘆號 `!`，草稿依然會維持一般對話模式，不再被誤觸成執行外部指令的模式。
body.en:
Reviewing code changes and typing responses in the terminal now comes with several improvements to detail viewing and typing.

While an approval prompt is open, you can now expand patch details directly in the conversation transcript without leaving the prompt to inspect the changes.

When tidying up the terminal view, pressing `Ctrl+L` clears the screen display. Earlier conversation messages remain available through `Ctrl+T` whenever you want to review them.

When backspacing in the input box exposes a leading exclamation mark `!`, the draft stays in ordinary chat mode instead of accidentally switching to the mode for running external commands.

items.original:
Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).
`Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).

title.zh-TW: 支援系統網路代理設定，網路請求逐一排隊審批並明定權限規範
title.en: System proxy settings supported, network approvals queued individually, and permission rules documented

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過特定通道連線或對外部請求有嚴密資安管制的環境中，網路連線行為現在更容易掌握。

現在輸入 `/experimental` 就能選擇加入 macOS 或 Windows 的系統代理伺服器（proxy，協助轉發網路封包的中繼伺服器）設定，讓工具連線直接遵循作業系統的網路轉發規則。

遇到需要手動核准的網路連線時，網路審批提示會在請求結束時自動關閉。多個連往同一個端點的並行請求也不會再同時跳出干擾，而是依序逐一跳出提示讓你確認。

應用程式伺服器（app-server）的說明文件中，也正式補齊了設定檔 `[permissions.network]` 底下的受控網路限制說明，並明列了哪些 `prompt-user` 指令規則必須取得最新的人工審批才能放行。
body.en:
In environments that require connections through specific channels or tightly control external requests for security, network connection behavior is now easier to keep track of.

Enter `/experimental` to opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings (relay servers that help forward network packets), so tool connections directly follow the operating system’s network forwarding rules.

For network connections that require manual approval, the network approval prompt now closes automatically when the request ends. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint no longer interrupt you with simultaneous prompts. Instead, prompts appear one at a time for you to confirm.

The app-server (application server) documentation now also covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` in the configuration file and explicitly lists which `prompt-user` command rules require fresh human approval before they can proceed.

items.original:
Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).

title.zh-TW: Realtime V3 語音自動存入對話歷史，上下文壓縮納入失敗回應產出
title.en: Realtime V3 speech saves automatically to chat history, and context compaction counts output from failed responses

body.zh-TW: 當你進行長時間的即時對話或複雜的多輪問答時，對話內容的完整記錄與記憶管理至關重要。在長期的 Realtime V3 即時語音對話中，隨著逐字稿長度增長，工具會即時將已結束的語音內容保存至聊天歷史記錄中。⟦好比速記員一邊開會一邊將說完的發言謄進議事錄，管帳人員在打包過長卷宗時，也會把印壞的草稿和漏蓋計費章的廢頁通通算入紙張重量。⟧在對話長度過長觸發自動上下文壓縮時，計算機制現在也會如實算入執行失敗回應留下的輸出，以及缺少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量數據的回應，確保容量估算不會失準。
body.en: When you have long real-time conversations or complex exchanges with multiple rounds of questions and answers, complete conversation records and memory management are essential. During long Realtime V3 voice conversations, the tool saves completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows. ⟦Imagine a stenographer transcribing completed remarks into the minutes as a meeting proceeds, while the bookkeeper packing up overly long files counts misprinted drafts and discarded pages missing billing stamps toward the total paper weight.⟧ When a conversation gets long enough to trigger automatic context compaction, the calculation now also counts retained output from failed responses and responses missing token usage data (the text units AI processes and bills for), keeping capacity estimates accurate.

items.original:
Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

title.zh-TW: 淘汰模型主動推薦替代方案，Linux musl 降低閒置記憶體佔用
title.en: Retiring models get replacement recommendations, and Linux musl reduces idle memory use

body.zh-TW:
開發者在維護長期專案或將工具部署在輕量環境時，模型升級與底層資源消耗現在都有更省心的安排。

如果正在使用的模型即將淘汰，內建的 `openai-docs` 技能（skill，擴充 AI 能力的指引包）在引導遷移時，會直接根據官方文件推薦合適的替代模型。

針對安裝部署，DotSlash 的設定清單現在會直接參照本次版本隨附發布的 Cargo 套件，確保版本依賴關係保持一致。

若是在 Linux musl 環境編譯，底層改用較少的記憶體配置區（allocator arenas，底層向系統申請記憶體的緩衝區塊），有效降低對話工作階段卸載之後殘留的閒置記憶體。
body.en:
For developers maintaining long-running projects or deploying tools in lightweight environments, model upgrades and underlying resource use now require less attention.

If the model you are using is being retired, the built-in `openai-docs` skill (a package of instructions that extends AI capabilities) now recommends a suitable replacement directly from the official documentation when guiding migration.

For installation and deployment, DotSlash manifests now directly reference the Cargo packages shipped with this release, keeping version dependencies consistent.

Builds for Linux musl now use fewer allocator arenas (buffer blocks used to request memory from the system), reducing idle memory left behind after conversation sessions unload.

items.original:
The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).
DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

title.zh-TW: 鍵盤支援選取對話紀錄，按單字換行翻頁與內建搜尋
title.en: Keyboard Transcript Selection with Word, Line, and Page Motions and Integrated Search

body.zh-TW: 查閱終端機裡長串的除錯紀錄時，頻繁移開雙手去抓滑鼠反白文字常常打斷思緒。⟦宛若在厚重字典裡用檢索標籤翻查單字，以前只能用肉眼一行行硬找並手動標記，現在手指一撥就能按章節跳頁並直接定位字彙。⟧對話紀錄（終端機中保留的歷史問答內容）現在完整支援純鍵盤選取操作。你能使用鍵盤按單字、整行或整頁幅度移動游標，精準框選想複製的段落。介面內建搜尋功能，當你請 AI 檢查長篇日誌並想擷取特定段落時，直接鍵入關鍵字就能跳到該行。所有移動與選取的按鍵組合也開放自訂，方便你依照習慣配置個人快捷鍵。
body.en: When reviewing long debug logs in the terminal, frequently moving your hands away to grab the mouse and highlight text often breaks your train of thought. ⟦Think of looking up words in a thick dictionary using index tabs: in the past, you had to scan line by line with your eyes and mark text manually, whereas now a flick of the finger lets you skip across sections and pinpoint a vocabulary word directly.⟧ The transcript (historical question-and-answer exchanges kept in the terminal) now fully supports keyboard-only selection. You can use the keyboard to move the cursor by word, line, or page increments to precisely highlight the passages you want to copy. The interface features integrated search, so when you ask AI to inspect long logs and want to capture specific sections, typing keywords takes you straight to that line. All keybindings for motion and selection are also open to customization, making it easy to configure your personal shortcuts based on your habits.

items.original: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面修復排版與離線退出，還原草稿保留附加圖片
title.en: Terminal Interface Fixes Rendering and Offline Exit While Preserving Image Attachments

body.zh-TW: 在終端機與 AI 密集互動時，文字排版錯亂或突發斷線往往會打亂操作節奏。非同步提問、選項清單、回答內容與對話紀錄回覆中的 Markdown（將文字標記為標題或粗體的輕量排版語法），現在皆能維持一致的渲染呈現。還原被清除的輸入框文字時，原本附加的本機圖片也會一起留下。終端介面也改善了重連後的復原，離線時輸入 `/quit` 或 `/exit` 也能正確處理。
body.en: When interacting intensively with AI in the terminal, garbled text formatting or sudden disconnections often disrupt the operational flow. Markdown (a lightweight markup syntax that formats text into headings or bold text) across asynchronous questions, choice lists, answers, and transcript replies is now consistently rendered. When restoring cleared composer text, original local image attachments are also preserved. The terminal interface also improves reconnection recovery, properly handling `/quit` or `/exit` even when offline.

items.original:
Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502)
Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820)

title.zh-TW: 新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型，支援內建與兩大雲端目錄
title.en: GPT-6.1 Terra Model Added with Support for Bundled and Two Major Cloud Catalogs

body.zh-TW: 規劃專案架構並評估模型效能時，能否在自己習慣的雲端託管環境調用最新架構是關鍵考量。⟦好比連鎖量販店引進新型高效冷氣，以前想購買只能透過少數專門管道，現在官方型錄與各大特約通路貨架都同步補齊規格。⟧Codex 模型目錄現已正式加入 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型。除了本地內建的預載型錄外，使用 Google Cloud 的 Vertex AI 或 AWS 的 Amazon Bedrock 託管服務的團隊，也能在各自的模型清單中看到它。在這三份目錄的任一份裡，都能選到 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en: When planning project architectures and evaluating model performance, being able to invoke the latest architecture in your preferred cloud hosting environment is a critical consideration. ⟦Consider a retail chain stocking a new high-efficiency air conditioner: where buyers previously had to rely on a few specialized channels, both the official catalog and the shelves of major authorized partners now carry the model simultaneously.⟧ The Codex model catalog has now officially added the GPT-6.1 Terra model. In addition to the local bundled catalog, teams using hosting services such as Vertex AI on Google Cloud or Amazon Bedrock on AWS can also see it in their respective model listings. You can select GPT-6.1 Terra from any of these three catalogs.

items.original: Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)

title.zh-TW: 討論串回復與分支保留授權，佇列後可接續，子串一併復原
title.en: Thread Resuming and Forking Preserve Approvals with Queue Resume and Child Thread Restoration

body.zh-TW:
將中斷的工作階段重新接續或另開分支時，對話狀態與先前確認過的設定往往需要被妥善延續。

現在使用 `codex queue --resume` 指令，能在將新訊息加入佇列後，自動喚醒並接續已卸載的討論串。

當你回復既有進度或建立分支時，先前已經過確認的放行批准與權限設定會完整保留，不必在分支裡逐項重新授權。

回復與分支過程也會一併保留推理 token（AI 思考過程消耗的計費文字單位）的累計數據。這避免了系統因遺失思考紀錄而誤判對話長度，導致過早觸發上下文壓縮。

若先前將某個討論串封存，現在只要解封存該父討論串，所有由它衍生出的子討論串都會同步復原。以往分支後總要重新確認權限、子串在解封存時不知去向的麻煩，現在都不會再發生。
body.en:
When resuming an interrupted session or branching into a new fork, conversation state and previously confirmed settings often need to be properly carried forward.

Running the `codex queue --resume` command now automatically wakes and resumes unloaded threads after queueing a new message.

When you resume existing progress or create a fork, previously acknowledged approvals and permission settings are preserved in full, eliminating the need to reauthorize permissions item by item in the branch.

The resume and fork process also retains cumulative counts for reasoning tokens (billable text units consumed during an AI thought process). This prevents the system from misjudging conversation length due to lost deliberation records, which previously triggered premature context compaction.

If a thread was previously archived, unarchiving that parent thread now restores all child threads spawned from it simultaneously. The past annoyances of repeatedly re-confirming permissions after branching or losing track of child threads upon unarchiving no longer occur.

items.original:
Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

title.zh-TW: 安全防護阻擋提示更清晰，提供替代提示詞直接選取
title.en: Clearer Safety-Block Explanations with Direct Selection of Safer Follow-Up Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特定提示詞若意外觸發安全防護，突然中斷的對話常讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦彷彿圖書館珍本庫的借閱櫃台，以前被拒絕調閱只得到一張空白退件單，現在館員會清楚說明受限章則，還會主動列出可借閱的替代篇章。⟧終端使用者介面（TUI，以文字選單排版的終端畫面）現在提供更清楚的安全攔截說明。當你的請求因安全原則遭到阻擋時，畫面會明確解釋被限制的具體原因，不再只丟出一行模糊的拒絕訊息。介面同時會自動生成數個調整過措辭的安全替代提示詞，你可以直接按鍵盤選取並重新送出。這讓你在探索程式碼防護或敏感測試情境時，能立刻知道邊界在哪，並快速調整詢問方向繼續工作。
body.en: When entering certain prompts in the terminal unexpectedly triggers safety guardrails, a sudden conversation halt often leaves users bewildered. ⟦Picture the circulation desk of a rare book library: where a denied request once yielded only a blank rejection slip, the librarian now clearly explains the restricted regulations and proactively suggests alternative chapters available for loan.⟧ The TUI (terminal interface formatted with text-based menus) now provides clearer safety-block explanations. When your request is blocked due to safety policies, the screen clearly explains the specific reason for the restriction instead of merely returning a vague rejection line. The interface simultaneously generates several rephrased, safe follow-up prompts that you can select directly with your keyboard and resubmit. When exploring code defenses or sensitive testing scenarios, this lets you immediately recognize boundaries and swiftly adjust your questioning direction to continue working.

items.original: Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)

title.zh-TW: 診斷指令新增專注網路選項，快速檢測連線與協定狀態
title.en: Focused Network Option Added to Doctor Command for Rapid Diagnostics

body.zh-TW:
當終端機突然連不上伺服器或回覆中斷時，快速抓出是本機環境還是網路連線出問題至關重要。⟦如同音響工程師拿著導線專用測試儀，以前排查雜音得把整套擴大機與調音台拆開通盤安檢，現在只要接上線頭就能單獨測量訊號導通狀況。⟧現在診斷工具新增了 `codex doctor --network-only` 參數選項。這項指令只針對設定、連線能力與 WebSocket（雙向即時通訊的網路協定）狀態做診斷。當你在公司內部網路或代理伺服器環境下遭遇請求逾時，只要打：

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

終端機就會只回報設定、連線與 WebSocket 這三項的檢查結果。
body.en:
When the terminal suddenly loses connection to the server or replies are cut off, quickly pinpointing whether the issue lies in the local environment or the network connection is critical. ⟦An audio engineer uses a dedicated cable tester: whereas troubleshooting noise previously required dismantling and inspecting the entire amplifier and mixing console, plugging in the leads now immediately tests signal continuity on its own.⟧ The diagnostic tool has now added the `codex doctor --network-only` option. This command runs diagnostics exclusively on configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket (a networking protocol for bidirectional real-time communication) status. When encountering request timeouts in corporate intranets or proxy environments, you simply run:

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

The terminal then reports only the configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket checks.

items.original: Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

title.zh-TW: 獨立執行器隨附於正式安裝包，整頓背景服務與建置工具
title.en: Standalone Executor Shipped in Official Packages Alongside Service and Build Improvements

body.zh-TW: 在建置環境部署與升級工具時，底層架構的打包完整度與資源釋放直接影響執行穩定。正式釋出的命令列工具與 app-server（應用程式背景伺服器）安裝包中，現在已直接隨附獨立執行器。背景服務修復了執行緒啟動與關閉時的競爭衝突，執行完成後會即時釋放占用資源。同時，macOS 上若安裝路徑包含中文等非 ASCII 字元，或程式仍在使用中，獨立版本的清理錯誤也已修好。在專案建置方面，Bazel 改採原始碼自編譯的 V8 引擎，搭配相符的 Rust 綁定並支援 Windows 原生 MSVC 封裝；開發與正式發行版本也全面標準化至 Node.js 24.22.1 與 Rust 1.95.0。以往在特定路徑清理失敗或背景程序殘留資源的問題，現在都已排除。
body.en: When deploying and upgrading tools in build environments, the packaging integrity and resource release of underlying architectures directly dictate execution stability. Canonical CLI and app-server (application background server) release packages now bundle the standalone executor directly. The background service fixes thread startup and shutdown races, promptly releasing occupied resources upon completion. Meanwhile, standalone release cleanup errors on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters such as Chinese have also been resolved. For project builds, Bazel switches to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. Development and release builds are also standardized across the board on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. Past issues where cleanups failed on specific paths or background processes left lingering resources are now eliminated.

items.original:
Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

title.zh-TW: 內建 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者，支援 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
title.en: Built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI Provider and Support for GPT-6.1 Terra

body.zh-TW:
如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 部署各項服務，現在可以直接透過 Vertex AI 調用模型，不用再自己撰寫複雜的轉接外掛。

設定檔只要加入：

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

就能直接切換為內建的 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者。同時，官方模型清單也加入了最新推出的 GPT-6.1 Terra，讓你在挑選模型時有更多元的運算選擇。

⟦宛如到連鎖租車行租賃商務車隊，以前想開特定廠牌還得自己找外包車行簽約，現在官方直接納入特約合作名單，還同步上架了最新款旗艦房車供你自由挑選。⟧

當你著手建置企業內部應用，想把 AI 運算統一收整在既有的 Google Cloud 專案與帳單下，只要在設定檔指定 `gcp`，就能立刻連接 Vertex AI 資源；需要測試最新模型能力時，也能直接在清單中選用 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en:
If you are used to deploying services on Google Cloud, you can now call models directly through Vertex AI without writing complex adapter plugins yourself.

Simply add the following to your configuration file:

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

This directly switches to the built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider. At the same time, the official model catalog now includes the newly released GPT-6.1 Terra, giving you more computing options when choosing models.

⟦Picture renting a commercial fleet from a car rental chain. In the past, driving a specific brand required finding and contracting with outside agencies on your own. Now the company directly adds them to its partner roster and puts the latest flagship sedan in the lineup for you to choose from.⟧

When building internal enterprise applications and consolidating AI compute under existing Google Cloud projects and billing, you only need to specify `gcp` in the configuration file to connect to Vertex AI resources immediately. When you need to test the latest model capabilities, you can also select GPT-6.1 Terra directly from the catalog.

items.original:
Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段選擇器支援儲存庫篩選，指令中心依目錄分組
title.en: Session Picker Supports Repository Filtering, Agent Command Center Groups by Directory

body.zh-TW:
當你同時在多個專案副本間切換工作時，要在落落長的工作階段清單裡找出剛剛開啟的對話往往得費一番工夫。

在搭配 Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行多工處理時，工作階段選擇器現在加入了儲存庫篩選機制，你可以快速過濾出屬於特定專案的工作階段。

⟦好比大型檔案庫整頓借閱卡，以前所有專案的借閱單全塞在同一個抽屜，找紀錄得一張張比對；現在能按專案名稱抽取專屬卡盒，櫃台還會按實體檔案夾分層收納。⟧

代理指令中心也同步支援目錄分組，會將關聯在同一工作樹目錄下的所有紀錄整合在一起，讓跨副本的工作階段瀏覽井然有序。當你一邊在主專案修復問題，另一邊在副本測試新功能時，只要開啟選擇器輸入專案名稱，就能切回目標對話，不再被其他專案的工作階段干擾。
body.en:
When juggling work across multiple project copies, locating a recently opened conversation in a long session list often takes considerable effort.

When multitasking with Git worktrees (a feature allowing multiple copies of the same project in parallel), the session picker now includes a repository filter, allowing you to quickly filter out sessions belonging to a specific project.

⟦Imagine a large archive reorganizing its checkout slips. Previously, slips from all projects were stuffed into a single drawer, forcing you to check records one by one. Now you can pull out a dedicated card box by project name, and the desk organizes them into tiers by physical folder.⟧

The agent command center now also supports directory grouping, bringing together all records associated with the same worktree directory to keep session navigation across copies neat and orderly. When you are fixing an issue in the main project while testing a new feature in a copy, you can simply open the picker and type the project name to switch back to the target conversation without distraction from other projects' sessions.

items.original: Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器 API 支援附加對話分支，實驗性拆分子討論串
title.en: App-Server API Supports Experimental Attached Thread Forks

body.zh-TW:
如果你正在透過應用伺服器介面開發專屬工具，想在同一個對話脈絡下嘗試不同解法時，管理獨立分支往往相當繁瑣。

`app-server` 的 API 現在加入了實驗性的附加對話分支（從既有對話衍生出附屬子討論串的機制）。這項功能讓應用程式能直接從既有對話拆出分支，既完整保留主線累積的上下文，又不會讓測試過程弄亂原本的紀錄。

⟦恰似在活頁筆記本貼上延伸標籤頁，以前想嘗試第二種草案只能整本重新謄寫，現在直接在關鍵頁面夾入附屬便箋，既保留原有筆記的脈絡，寫壞了也能隨時抽換。⟧

當你需要讓使用者對同一個問題評估多種修改方案時，就能透過這組介面拉出附屬討論串進行推演，讓主線對話隨時維持乾淨。
body.en:
If you are developing custom tools through the app-server interface and want to try different solutions within the same conversational context, managing separate branches can often be cumbersome.

The `app-server` API now includes experimental attached thread forks (a mechanism for branching secondary sub-threads from an existing conversation). This feature allows applications to branch directly off an existing conversation, preserving the full context accumulated in the main thread while preventing experiments from cluttering original records.

⟦Think of attaching extension tabs to a loose-leaf notebook. Previously, trying a second draft meant rewriting the entire notebook from scratch. Now you insert an attached memo directly into key pages, preserving the original context while letting you swap out bad drafts at any time.⟧

When you need users to evaluate multiple revision options for the same issue, you can use this interface to spin off secondary threads for exploration while keeping the primary conversation completely clean.

items.original: Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)

title.zh-TW: 支援對話途中調整思考力度，預設開放動態切換
title.en: Support for Adjusting Reasoning Effort Mid-Conversation, Enabled by Default

body.zh-TW:
向 AI 提問時如果一開始只隨口聊聊，隨後卻突然碰上需要抽絲剝繭的複雜架構，往往會受限於最初設定的思考程度。

針對有支援的模型，現在已經預設允許在對話途中直接修改思考力度（決定模型在回答前投入多少推理運算的參數）。你不再需要為了讓 AI 想得更深入而特地中斷對話另開新局，交談到一半隨時能依照問題難度靈活增減思考量。

⟦跟下西洋棋時切換思考時限一樣，以前開局選了快棋就只能一路快打到底，現在遇到膠著局面能當場多要幾分鐘長考，解開難題後又能切回節奏，不必把整盤棋推倒重來。⟧

當你原本只是請它解讀一段日常日誌，中途突然想探討分散式鎖的死結原因時，就能當場調高力度，讓模型針對核心邏輯進行深度推理。
body.en:
When asking an AI questions, starting with casual chat and then suddenly running into a complex architecture that demands deep dissection often leaves you constrained by your initial thinking depth.

For supported models, changing reasoning effort (the parameter determining how much reasoning computation the model invests before answering) during a conversation is now enabled by default. You no longer need to interrupt the conversation and start a new session just to make the AI think more deeply; you can flexibly adjust the amount of thinking midway based on question complexity.

⟦A chess clock adjustment reflects this transition. Previously, choosing blitz at the opening meant rushing through the entire match. Now, when a stalemate strikes, you can claim a few extra minutes on the spot to think deeply, then switch back to your normal pace once the puzzle is solved without resetting the board.⟧

When you initially ask it to interpret a routine log and suddenly decide to explore the root cause of a distributed lock deadlock midway through, you can increase the effort on the spot to let the model perform deep reasoning on the core logic.

items.original: Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)

title.zh-TW: 新設定檔預設啟用第二代記憶，支援匯入外部代理記憶
title.en: Fresh Profiles Enable Memory v2 by Default with Support for Importing External-Agent Memories

body.zh-TW:
每次建立新的個人設定檔時，如果希望 AI 能記住你的偏好或從其他工具轉移習慣，往往需要不少手動設定。

現在建立全新設定檔時，工具會預設啟用第二代記憶架構（讓工具跨對話保存使用者偏好的機制）。這套架構也同步支援匯入外部代理的記憶資料，能直接讀取其他 AI 工具先前累積的偏好與操作紀錄。

⟦如同搬進全新裝潢的智慧住宅，以前每次換新家都要重新訓練管家認識你的生活作息，現在進門就有現成的智慧管家隨時待命，還能直接把前任管家的備忘手冊整本讀取完畢。⟧

當你從其他開發助理切換到 Codex 時，不用再從頭教它你的排版風格與常用語法，只要把既有的記憶檔匯入，新設定檔就能立刻依循你的慣用模式工作。
body.en:
Whenever you create a new profile, having the AI remember your preferences or transfer habits from other tools usually requires considerable manual setup.

When creating fresh profiles, the tool now enables memory v2 (a mechanism allowing the tool to preserve user preferences across conversations) by default. This architecture also supports importing external-agent memories, directly reading preferences and operational logs accumulated in other AI tools.

⟦Consider moving into a newly renovated smart home. Previously, each move meant retraining a butler to learn your daily routine. Now, a ready-made smart butler is on standby the moment you enter, capable of reading through your previous butler's entire memo notebook.⟧

When switching from another coding assistant to Codex, you do not need to reteach your formatting style and preferred syntax from scratch; simply import your existing memory files, and the fresh profile will immediately work according to your established habits.

items.original: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面在參數錯誤時保持可編輯，新工作階段沿用預設審核者
title.en: TUI Preferences Remain Editable on Invalid Settings, Fresh Sessions Honor Default Reviewer

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面操作工具時，如果遇到執行參數填寫錯誤，偏好設定選單一旦被連帶鎖死，往往會讓人動彈不得。

針對終端使用者介面（以純文字排版的終端機視窗），現在即便執行設定中存在無效參數，偏好設定依然保持可編輯狀態，且修改後能立即生效。新開啟的終端工作階段在未提供明確覆寫時，現在也會確實遵循伺服器的預設審核者規則。

⟦彷彿汽車儀表板的設定選單，以前只要感測器回報異常數值，整個操作面板就跟著卡死無法調整；現在各項控制選項依然能隨意修改並即時生效，新發動的車輛也會主動遵循車隊預設的安全指派。⟧

無論是不慎輸入了無效路徑，或是剛啟動全新的終端對話，介面都不會再無故罷工，各項審核權限也能正常運作。
body.en:
When operating tools in a terminal interface, if execution parameters are entered incorrectly and the preference menu freezes as a result, you are often left stuck.

For the terminal user interface (a text-based terminal display), preferences now remain editable and take effect immediately even when invalid parameters exist in execution settings. Fresh terminal sessions also properly honor the server's default approval reviewer rules when no explicit override is provided.

⟦The settings menu on a car dashboard mirrors this behavior. In the past, whenever a sensor reported an abnormal reading, the entire console froze and prevented adjustments. Now control options remain fully editable with immediate effect, and newly started vehicles actively follow default safety assignments set by the fleet.⟧

Whether you accidentally enter an invalid path or just launched a brand new terminal conversation, the interface will no longer freeze without cause, and approval permissions continue to function normally.

items.original:
Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)

title.zh-TW: 中斷與取消時即刻停止背景運算，模型找不到不再盲目重試
title.en: Promptly Stop Background Tasks on Interrupt and Cancellation, Stop Blind Retries for Missing Models

body.zh-TW:
當你在操作過程中按下停止或遇到無效請求時，背景程式如果持續空轉或重複嘗試，往往會白白消耗運算資源與等待時間。

⟦有如辦公大樓的撤銷派工機制，以前專案喊停後外包廠商依然繼續趕工，送錯地址的公文還在不斷重複投遞；現在只要前端發出取消通知，所有外派作業與無效配送都會立刻剎車。⟧

第一項改動針對遠端 MCP 工具（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）。如果本機端已經取消或不再等待回傳結果，會主動向遠端發送取消通知，避免遠端伺服器徒勞運算。

第二項調整落在代理訊息排隊機制。當你在對話中按鍵中斷執行，或是切換到計畫模式時，已排隊的訊息不會再擅自重啟工作。

第三項改動則是在模型提供者回報找不到指定型號時，工具會立即停止重複嘗試，並完整保留原本的錯誤訊息。

以前遇到操作中斷或設定失效時，背景可能會持續重試或再度喚醒任務，現在各項失效請求都能及時收手。
body.en:
When you press stop during an operation or encounter an invalid request, background processes that continue idling or repeatedly retrying waste computing resources and waiting time.

⟦An office building's dispatch cancellation mechanism works in much the same way. Previously, contractors continued rushing work after a project was halted, and misaddressed documents were repeatedly redelivered. Now, once the front desk issues a cancellation notice, all dispatched tasks and invalid deliveries brake immediately.⟧

The first change applies to remote MCP tools (protocols that connect AI to external tools). If the local side has cancelled or no longer waits for returned results, it actively sends a cancellation notice to the remote side, preventing remote servers from wasting compute.

The second adjustment targets the agent message queuing mechanism. When you press a key to interrupt execution during a conversation or switch to Plan mode, queued messages will no longer restart work without permission.

The third change stops retrying immediately when a model provider reports that a specified model was not found, fully preserving the original error message.

Previously, when operations were interrupted or settings failed, background processes might continuously retry or wake tasks back up; now invalid requests cease promptly.

items.original:
Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)

title.zh-TW: 市集網址驗證補強防護，防範 Git 連線至未經授權的主機
title.en: Marketplace URL Validation Strengthened to Prevent Git Connecting to Unauthorized Hosts

body.zh-TW:
從擴充市集下載外掛或套件時，工具能否嚴格把關下載來源，攸關整個開發環境的安全。

市集網址的驗證機制現在補上了防護漏洞。以往在比對網址時存在落差，可能導致 Git 最終連線的主機，與安全名單中所允許的主機並不一致。這個驗證漏洞已經補上，Git 不會再連到與允許名單所檢查的不同主機。

⟦猶如社區門禁核對訪客名單，以前警衛登記的地址和訪客實際去的地方可能對不上，現在這個對不上的漏洞已經補上。⟧

這個問題已經修好，安裝市集套件時不會再因網址歧異而誤連至未授權的外部主機。
body.en:
When downloading plugins or packages from an extension marketplace, whether a tool strictly verifies download sources is vital to the security of your entire development environment.

The marketplace URL validation mechanism has now closed a security gap. In the past, discrepancies during URL matching could cause Git to ultimately connect to a different host from the one permitted on the safe list. This validation gap has been closed, ensuring Git will no longer connect to a host different from the one checked against the allowlist.

⟦Checking visitor logs at a gated community entrance reflects this safeguard. Previously, the address recorded by a guard might not match where a visitor actually went; now this mismatch loophole has been firmly closed.⟧

This issue has been fixed, so installing marketplace packages will no longer inadvertently connect to unauthorized external hosts due to URL discrepancies.

items.original: Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

title.zh-TW: 遠端代理支援雲端擴充技能，放寬專案大檔上傳限制
title.en: Remote agents support cloud plugin skills, lifting upload limits on large project files

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣透過 `--remote-agent` 在遠端主機執行代理任務，常需要搭配外掛技能或上傳規格書等參考資料。現在透過 `/plugin` 連線的雲端擴充套件技能，已經正式支援遠端代理工作階段。這些技能會直接顯示在斜線選單中，在訊息開頭輸入就能直接呼叫。輸入 `/skills` 會依套件分組列在遠端代理技能清單，輸入 `/skills reload` 即可重新整理。⟦跟出海科考的探險船連線一樣，以前通訊受限，既無法調用總部的專家工具箱，傳送高解析海圖還會被中斷；現在遠端船隻能隨時掛載雲端技能，大型觀測檔也能順暢送達。⟧從 `/projects` 新增 PDF、二進位檔案或大於約 8 MB 的檔案到遠端專案時，過去容易上傳失敗，現在都能順利完成上傳。
body.en: If you often run agent tasks on remote hosts with `--remote-agent`, you frequently need plugin skills or have to upload reference materials like specification documents. Cloud plugin skills connected via `/plugin` are now officially supported in remote agent sessions. These skills appear directly in the `/` menu and can be called by typing them at the start of a message. Running `/skills` lists them grouped by plugin under `Remote agent skills`, and running `/skills reload` refreshes the list. ⟦Much like staying in touch with an offshore research expedition, where limited communications once blocked access to headquarters' specialist toolkits and broke transfers of high-resolution nautical charts, the remote vessel can now attach cloud skills anytime and large observation files arrive smoothly.⟧ When adding PDFs, binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB from `/projects` to a remote project, uploads previously failed often, but now complete successfully.

items.original:
Added skills from the cloud plugins you connected with `/plugin` to `--remote-agent` sessions, so they now appear in the `/` menu and can be typed at the start of a message, `/skills` lists them grouped by plugin under `Remote agent skills`, and `/skills reload` lists them again.
Fixed adding PDFs, other binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB to a remote project from `/projects` in `--remote-agent` sessions, which failed and now upload successfully.

title.zh-TW: macOS 的 Option 快捷鍵開箱即用，免額外修改終端機設定
title.en: macOS Option-key shortcuts work out of the box without extra terminal configuration

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上使用命令列時，想按下 `alt+m` 等組合鍵往往會遇到按鍵無反應或打出特殊符號的困擾。macOS 版本的 Option 組合鍵預設行為迎來更新。以前在終端機裡按 Option 鍵快捷鍵時，若沒有事先把 Option 鍵設定為 Alt 鍵，按下後可能毫無反應，或者直接打出 `µ` 等特殊字元；現在這些快捷鍵開箱就能直接生效，不再需要手動修改終端機偏好設定。⟦像使用新買的遊戲鍵盤一樣，以前得先自行修改按鍵映射才能讓特殊功能鍵生效，現在接上主機就能直接辨識預設捷徑。⟧如果你仍偏好原有的輸入行為，把環境變數 `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` 這個設定設為 0，就會回到舊行為，終端機便維持舊有的按鍵對應規則。
body.en: When using the command line on a Mac, pressing key combinations such as `alt+m` often led to no response or typed unexpected special characters. The default behavior for Option-key combinations on macOS has been updated. Previously, when pressing Option-key shortcuts in your terminal without configuring Option to act as Alt beforehand, pressing them did nothing or directly typed special characters such as `µ`; now these shortcuts work right out of the box without manually changing terminal preferences. ⟦Picture plugging in a newly bought gaming keyboard: previously, you had to reconfigure key mappings yourself before special function keys worked, but now connecting it to the computer immediately recognizes default shortcuts.⟧ If you still prefer the original input behavior, setting the environment variable `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` will return to the old behavior, keeping your terminal's previous key mapping rules.

items.original: Changed the default for macOS Option-key shortcuts such as `alt+m`, which now work out of the box without setting Option to act as Alt in your terminal, where previously pressing them did nothing or typed a character such as `µ`; set `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` to go back to the old behavior.

title.zh-TW: 跳過權限模式增設安全防線，保護高風險指令並排除子代理停頓
title.en: Permission-skipping mode adds safety guardrails, protecting high-risk commands and resolving subagent stalls

body.zh-TW: 當你啟用 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 參數跑自動化任務時，高風險操作與工作區邊界有了更清楚的防線。⟦類似拿著快速通行證進出廠區，以前只要出示證件就能進入所有庫房；現在特定管制區與管理規定仍需查驗，但一般走道上的隨行助理不再被警衛無端攔下盤查。⟧該模式不再自動放行內建清單中的受保護指令，這些指令會恢復一般審核，其餘指令仍照常免詢問執行。若企業管理員要求工作區外的指令或檔案存取必須經過審查，`--dangerously-skip-permissions` 與設為自動放行的外掛代理都不會跳過；無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）則會直接拒絕此類請求。子代理在此模式下存取工作區外檔案時，先前會卡頓約 60 秒、卡在檔案權限上，現在讀寫均可直接通行，搭配 `-p` 也不再停頓，自訂的明確拒絕規則仍維持有效。
body.en: When you enable `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to run automated tasks, high-risk operations and workspace boundaries have clearer guardrails. ⟦Think of how a fast pass works in a factory facility: previously, flashing your badge opened every storeroom, but now restricted zones and governance policies still require verification while accompanying assistants in common corridors are no longer needlessly stopped by guards.⟧ The mode no longer automatically approves commands on the built-in protected list, which now return to normal review, while other commands continue to run without asking. If enterprise administrators require commands or file access outside the workspace to be reviewed, neither `--dangerously-skip-permissions` nor plugin agents set to auto-allow will bypass those checks. In addition, headless mode (running without a terminal visual interface) now directly denies such requests. When subagents accessed files outside the workspace in this mode, they previously stalled for about 60 seconds on file permissions; both reads and writes now proceed directly without prompting, runs with `-p` no longer pause, and custom explicit deny rules remain in effect.

items.original:
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so commands on the built-in list of protected commands are no longer approved automatically and go through the usual checks, while every other command still runs without asking.
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and plugin agents set to auto-allow so they no longer approve terminal commands or file access outside the workspace when your Gemini Enterprise administrator requires those to be reviewed, and headless runs now deny such requests instead.
Fixed subagents stalling for about 60 seconds on file permissions under `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, so reads and writes outside the workspace now go through without a prompt, and headless `-p` runs with the flag no longer wait on any remaining interaction, while your explicit deny rules still apply.

title.zh-TW: 存取工作區外的檔案改為單一授權，不再一次開放全部目錄
title.en: File access outside the workspace switches to single-path authorization, ending broad directory exposure

body.zh-TW: 碰到代理需要讀取工作區外部的特定設定檔時，提示視窗不再要求你交出整個外部目錄的控制權。代理請求存取工作區外的檔案時，確認提示會明確顯示 `Allow access to this file?`。你可以針對當前指定的單一路徑，選擇在本次對話中永遠允許或拒絕，或將設定直接寫進 `settings.json`；系統不會再因為單一檔案的請求，就一口氣開放工作區外所有檔案的存取權限。⟦好比向大樓管理員借鑰匙，以前只要借用單一辦公室，就得把整棟大樓的門禁全面解鎖；現在管理員只會精準發放你指名那間會議室的感應卡，離開後其餘房間依然安全上鎖。⟧這讓你在引用公用設定或全域工具時，既能放心放行特定文件，又不必擔心整個硬碟門戶大開。
body.en: When an agent needs to read a specific configuration file outside the workspace, the prompt window no longer asks you to surrender control over the entire external directory. When an agent requests access to a file outside the workspace, the confirmation prompt clearly displays `Allow access to this file?`. You can choose to always allow or deny that single path for the current conversation, or write the setting directly into `settings.json`; the system will no longer open access to all files outside the workspace just because of a single file request. ⟦Consider borrowing keys from a building manager: whereas requesting a single office once required opening up access across the entire building, the manager now issues a keycard solely for your designated conference room, leaving all other rooms securely locked.⟧ When referencing shared configurations or global tools, this lets you confidently approve specific documents without worrying about leaving your entire hard drive wide open.

items.original: Changed the prompt shown when the agent asks for access to a file outside the workspace, which now reads `Allow access to this file?` and offers to always allow or deny that one path for the conversation or in `settings.json`, instead of turning on access to everything outside the workspace.

title.zh-TW: 修復指令選單與多任務循環錯誤，並強化遠端連線重試機制
title.en: Fixed command menus and queued message retry loops, and strengthened remote connection retries

body.zh-TW:
日常切換各類執行模式與操控通道時，幾處影響操作流暢度的小毛病現在都已獲得改善。

使用 `agy -p` 執行單次輸出時，不再於背景發送模型請求來生成終端機根本不會顯示的對話標題，省下多餘的模型等待與消耗。

建立遠端控制連線時，若在建立初期遇上短暫的網路波動或伺服器抖動，會主動重新嘗試連線，不再直接中斷離開。

代理執行出錯當下若剛好有排隊中的訊息，先前會陷入連續瘋狂重試的迴圈，現在這些排隊訊息會暫停並等待你的下一道指令。

在 `agy acp` 工作階段中，斜線選單修正為列出當前工作階段代理的指令與技能，自訂代理的專屬工具也能正常顯示，不再誤列預設代理的選項。

以前在這些情境下容易遇到連線驟斷或無效重試，現在各類執行模式都能穩定收尾。
body.en:
Several small issues that affected operational smoothness when switching across execution modes and control channels have now been resolved.

Running single outputs with `agy -p` no longer makes a background model request to generate a conversation title that the terminal never shows, saving redundant model waits and resource usage.

When establishing Remote Control connections, encountering brief network fluctuations or server jitter during initial setup now triggers automatic retries instead of immediately dropping the connection.

If messages were queued at the moment the agent encountered an error, the agent previously entered a rapid retry loop, but those queued messages now pause and wait for your next command.

In `agy acp` sessions, the `/` menu has been corrected to list the commands and skills of the agent running the session, properly displaying custom agents' dedicated tools instead of mistakenly listing the default agent's options.

Where sudden disconnections or futile retry loops once occurred in these scenarios, various execution modes now conclude cleanly and reliably.

items.original:
Improved `agy -p` runs so they no longer make a background model request to generate a conversation title that print mode never shows.
Improved Remote Control connections, which now retry a brief network or server error while setting up a new connection instead of dropping it.
Fixed the agent re-running a failed turn in a rapid loop when messages were queued at the moment it hit an error, so queued messages now wait for your next message.
Fixed the `/` menu listing the commands and skills of a default agent instead of those of the agent the session actually runs, so in `agy acp` sessions it now shows that session's agent, including a custom agent's commands.

title.zh-TW: 擴充套件防範惡意路徑穿越，阻擋符號連結並放寬欄位驗證
title.en: Plugins guard against malicious path traversal, blocking symbolic links and relaxing field validation

body.zh-TW: 從外部下載社群擴充套件或開啟陌生的專案儲存庫時，外掛的檔案操作與載入範圍受到更嚴密的防護。⟦如同租借公共置物櫃，以前可能藉由暗道打通鄰近隔間；現在置物櫃加裝防護鋼板，嚴禁穿透到其他櫃位，標籤格式不符也只會貼上警告而非直接退件。⟧`agy plugin` 的各項指令會拒絕不安全的套件名稱並回報 `invalid plugin name`，且禁止寫入套件資料夾外或透過符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）寫入，防止惡意套件覆寫 `mcp_config.json` 等設定檔。工作區內的 `.agents/plugins.json` 與 `.agents/skills.json` 限制僅能從工作區或儲存庫內部載入，以絕對路徑、`../` 或捷徑指向外部的項目一律略過。而 `agy plugin validate` 遇到未知欄位時改為發出警告並略過，其餘擴充設定照常檢查。
body.en: When downloading community plugins from external sources or opening unfamiliar repositories, plugin file operations and loading boundaries are now more tightly protected. ⟦Public storage lockers provide a useful parallel: where hidden passages might once have broken through adjacent compartments, lockers now feature steel reinforcement plates that strictly prevent breaches into neighboring units, while nonconforming label formats merely receive a warning rather than outright rejection.⟧ Commands under `agy plugin` reject unsafe plugin names with `invalid plugin name`, and refuse to write outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links (shortcut files pointing to another location), preventing malicious plugins from overwriting configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`. Items listed in a workspace's `.agents/plugins.json` or `.agents/skills.json` are restricted to load only from within the workspace or repository root, and entries pointing externally via absolute paths, `../`, or shortcuts are skipped. In addition, when `agy plugin validate` encounters unknown fields, it now emits a warning and skips them while checking remaining extension settings normally.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` so an unknown field under `extensions["com.google.antigravity"]` in `plugin.json` is reported as a warning that the field is ignored instead of an error, and the plugin's other extension settings are still checked.
Improved protection against malicious plugins: `agy plugin` import, install, uninstall, enable, and disable now reject plugin names that are not safe file names with `invalid plugin name`, and refuse to write outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links, so an imported plugin can no longer overwrite other configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`.
Improved protection against untrusted repositories: plugins and skills listed in a workspace's `.agents/plugins.json` or `.agents/skills.json` now load only from inside the workspace or its repository root, and entries that point elsewhere through absolute paths, `../`, or symbolic links are skipped.

title.zh-TW: MCP 協定修復 OAuth 重新連線錯誤，並完整傳遞工具自訂參數
title.en: MCP protocol fixes OAuth reconnection errors and delivers custom tool parameters intact
