title.en: 3D Visual Skill Runs Twice as Fast, Triggering Multi-Agent Pipelines Only for Polished Projects

body.zh-TW: 建構立體場景或 3D 網頁時，最怕簡單模型也硬塞進繁複的審查流程而拖慢節奏。現在 `/game-3d-visuals` 預設跳過額外的視覺計畫審查，改為只跑一輪渲染與參考圖對照修復，執行時間縮短約一半。⟦宛如相館沖印照片，一般生活快照直接過機列印，只有拿出底片精修或指名沙龍質感的作品，才會送進暗房讓師傅分工調色。⟧這項技能也不再凡事介入，只有遇到需要精緻成果的工作（例如提供參考圖片、Blender 模型，或明確要求高畫質）才會自動啟動。快速建置的 3D 頁面與小型遊戲會直接生成，不必在多代理人管線中空等。
body.en: When building three-dimensional scenes or 3D web pages, the biggest worry is having simple models forced through a tedious review process that drags out progress. Now `/game-3d-visuals` skips the separate visual-plan review by default and runs only one render-versus-reference fix round, cutting execution time roughly in half. ⟦Like a photo studio developing prints, everyday snapshots run straight through the printer, while only film brought in for retouching or fine-art salon portraits gets sent into the darkroom for artisans to color-grade.⟧ The skill no longer intervenes across the board, starting automatically only for tasks requiring polished results (such as providing a reference image, Blender models, or an explicit high-fidelity request). Quick 3D pages and small games are built directly without waiting in a multi-agent pipeline.

items.original:
`/game-3d-visuals` finishes in about half the time: it skips the separate visual-plan review and runs one render-vs-reference fix round by default
`/game-3d-visuals` now starts on its own only for polished 3D work (a reference image, Blender, or an explicit high-fidelity ask); quick 3D pages and games are built directly instead of waiting on its multi-agent pipeline

title.zh-TW: 微型修改略過前置測試，規劃指令與審查關卡界線更分明
title.en: Micro-Edits Skip Upfront Tests, Sharpening Boundaries for Planning Commands and Review Gates

body.zh-TW:
只是想改個按鈕顏色或微調一行設定，如果每次都要先寫一個失敗的測試案例，往往讓人感到多此一舉。現在微小的文字、樣式、設定修改、拋棄式原型、單檔腳本或網頁，或要求快速結果的任務，都不會再強制先寫失敗測試。其他常規修復改在最後一次編輯後跑一次完整測試套件，並在長測試期間於 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）回報進度。⟦就跟裁縫店換顆扣子不必大費周章畫版型一樣，以前動一針就要走完整套驗收，現在小修補俐落交件，大工程在送出門前也一定等客人點頭才寄出。⟧

對小變更輸入 `/plan` 時，Muse 會認真規劃步驟而非直接實作。這項技能會辨識內容來源，把看似要實作的任務文字當成規劃對象。使用者審查關卡也明確推遲對外操作，在檢視核准前暫停執行，防止步驟超前寫入追蹤器或對話紀錄。
body.en:
When you only want to change a button color or tweak a single config line, being forced to write a failing test case first often feels unnecessary. Now tiny text, style, or config changes, throwaway prototypes, one-file scripts or pages, and requests for a quick result no longer start by writing a failing test. Other routine fixes run the full test suite once after the last edit, reporting progress on the status line (the status bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) during long test runs. ⟦Think of a tailor replacing a single button without drafting an entire pattern: while every single stitch used to require a full inspection, small mends are now handed over promptly, and major alterations wait for the client's approval before being delivered.⟧

When entering `/plan` for a small change, Muse carefully plans out the steps instead of implementing them directly. The skill identifies how the content arrived, reading implement-shaped task text as the planning subject rather than an implementation request. A user review gate also explicitly defers outward-facing actions, pausing execution until post-inspection approval to prevent bounded steps from running ahead into tracker and chat writes.

items.original:
Tiny text, style, or config changes, throwaway prototypes, one-file scripts or pages, and requests for a quick result no longer start by writing a failing test; other fixes run the broad test suite once after the last edit and post a status line during long test runs
A user review gate now explicitly defers outward-facing actions until post-inspection approval, so bounded steps stop instead of running ahead into tracker and chat writes
`/plan` on a small change now plans instead of implementing it — the skill keys the explicit case on how its body arrived, so implement-shaped task text is read as the planning subject, not an implement request

title.zh-TW: 強化研究筆記整合報告指引，重要成果細節優先排列
title.en: Enhanced Research Note Guidance Puts Critical Result Details First in Final Reports

body.zh-TW: 當你請助理執行多方調研時，繁雜的背景調查筆記往往會淹沒最終報告中的核心結論。新版強化了引導規則，協助代理人更有條理地把調研成果與筆記整理進最終成果報告中。⟦好比資深主編排版晨報，讀者最關心的重大數據與頭條結論直接印在頭版最上方，滿滿十幾頁的採訪草稿則整齊收在後頭備查。⟧在工作流程的指導原則中，產出大型結果的重要細節現在會固定排在冗長的研究筆記之前。這讓你打開報告就能立刻掌握最具分量的關鍵產出，不必再費力翻越整大段的參考筆記才找到重點。
body.en: When asking an assistant to carry out multi-faceted research, sprawling background investigation notes often drown out the core findings in the final report. The new release strengthens guidance rules to help agents organize research findings and notes into the final report with greater structure. ⟦A veteran editor lays out the morning paper by printing the key figures and headline takeaways right at the top of page one, keeping dozens of pages of interview drafts filed neatly in the back for reference.⟧ In workflow guidance, key details for large results are now consistently placed ahead of lengthy research notes. This allows you to grasp the most substantial findings immediately upon opening the report without wading through large blocks of reference notes to find the point.

items.original:
Better guidance for carrying research findings and notes into final reports
Workflow guidance keeps large-result details ahead of lengthy research notes

title.zh-TW: 本機通訊埠權限獨立設定，同指令重複網路請求不再反覆確認
title.en: Local Port Permissions Configure Independently, Ending Repeated Confirmations for Same-Command Network Requests

body.zh-TW:
在沙盒裡執行本機網頁伺服器或測試 API 時，以往的網路規則很難精準控制開放哪些本機連接埠。現在權限設定檔能透過 `network.local_ports` 開放指定連接埠，個別設為 `allow`、`ask` 或 `deny`。Linux 選 `ask` 每次連線提示，macOS 每個工作階段詢問一次。`network.targets` 的環回項目現在會遭拒絕，必須遷移至 `network.local_ports`。舊版無法開啟儲存本機連接埠規則或受管理連接埠限制的對話，須更新；其他對話不受影響。⟦就像園區警衛換上專用閘門，各庫房個別發卡；送貨員登記一次後，同趟往返不再反覆盤查。⟧

核准非互動式指令的網路請求後，同一指令執行期間，對相同主機、連接埠與協定的後續請求不再重複詢問。若 `/permissions` 變更失敗，也會直接列出無法儲存的原因。
body.en:
When running local web servers or testing APIs inside a sandbox, previous network rules made it difficult to precisely control which local ports were opened. Permission profiles can now open chosen ports to sandboxed commands via `network.local_ports`, setting each port individually to `allow`, `ask`, or `deny`. Selecting `ask` prompts on each connection under Linux and once per session under macOS. Loopback entries in `network.targets` are now rejected and must be migrated to `network.local_ports`. Older builds cannot open chats that saved local-port rules or managed local-port limits and require an update, though other chats are unaffected. ⟦Security guards at a corporate campus install dedicated gates and issue access cards for individual storerooms; once a courier logs in, subsequent trips during the same run are no longer questioned repeatedly.⟧

After you approve a network request for a non-interactive command once, subsequent requests to the exact same host, port, and protocol no longer prompt for confirmation while that command runs. If a `/permissions` change fails, it also directly names why the update could not be saved.

items.original:
Permission profiles can open chosen local development ports to sandboxed commands with `network.local_ports` (`allow`, `ask`, or `deny` per port); `ask` prompts for each connection on Linux and once per session on macOS; a loopback entry in `network.targets` is now rejected, so move it to `network.local_ports`; an older Muse build cannot open a chat that saved local-port rules or a managed local-port limit, so update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
After you allow a network request once, the same non-interactive command's later requests to that exact host, port, and protocol no longer ask you again while it runs
`/permissions` now names why a permission change could not be saved

title.zh-TW: 沙盒禁止規則涵蓋未存在路徑，寫入受阻明確提示解法
title.en: Sandbox Deny Rules Cover Nonexistent Paths, Clearly Explaining Fixes When Writes Are Blocked

body.zh-TW:
面對沙盒環境跳出的唯讀檔案系統錯誤，以往常讓人摸不著頭緒。當沙盒指令嘗試寫入工作階段的可寫根目錄之外（例如家目錄下把算過結果暫存起來的快取路徑），介面不再只丟出冰冷的檔案系統錯誤，而是會明確說明受到沙盒阻擋，並主動列出解法：包含透過 `workspace_roots` 授權、以非沙盒模式單次執行，或是將快取路徑指向工作區或 `/tmp` 目錄。⟦如同大樓嚴格管制裝修，未經核准的新增隔間在動工前就被直接擋下，走錯出口時保全會附上通行指引，施工半途中斷也會將空箱清理乾淨。⟧

安全防護也進一步加固：拒絕規則現在完整覆蓋沙盒指令中尚未存在的路徑，徹底封鎖建立行為且不留痕跡。若指令在執行中途被強制終止，殘留的空白佔位檔會自動清理，不再干擾下一個套用相同拒絕規則的指令。
body.en:
Running into a read-only filesystem error inside a sandbox environment often used to leave developers puzzled. When a sandboxed command attempts to write outside the session's writable roots (such as a cache path under the home directory that temporarily stores computed results), the interface no longer just throws a raw filesystem error. Instead, it clearly explains that the sandbox blocked the write and proactively lists remedies: granting access via `workspace_roots`, running unsandboxed for a single run, or pointing the cache path to the workspace or the `/tmp` directory. ⟦Strict building management regulates renovations by blocking unauthorized partitions before work begins, offering detour directions when someone heads toward the wrong exit, and clearing away empty boxes if construction halts midway.⟧

Security defenses have also been reinforced: deny rules now fully cover paths that do not exist yet in sandboxed shell commands, blocking creation outright without leaving any trace behind. If a command is killed mid-run, leftover empty placeholder files are cleaned up automatically, preventing them from interfering with the next command that applies the same deny rules.

items.original:
Security: Deny rules now cover paths that do not exist yet in sandboxed shell commands, blocking their creation without leaving anything behind
When a sandboxed shell command fails writing outside the session's writable roots (for example a cache under the home directory failing with `Read-only file system`), the failure now explains that the sandbox blocked it and names the `workspace_roots` grant, a one-time unsandboxed run, and workspace-or-`/tmp` cache options, instead of the raw filesystem error
A sandboxed shell command killed mid-run no longer breaks the next command with the same deny rules; its leftover empty placeholder is now cleaned up automatically

title.zh-TW: 工作區授權支援多根目錄，版本控制指令納入沙盒防護
title.en: Workspace Grants Support Multiple Roots While Sandboxing Version Control Commands

body.zh-TW:
處理跨多個程式庫的大型專案時，檔案工具與版本控制指令的防護邊界至關重要。現在 Shell 指令可寫入用戶端以 `workspaceRoots` 授權的每個工作區根目錄，不再受限於主目錄；Shell 與檔案工具都會拒絕存取不再指向原位置的根目錄。降級工作階段復原遺失最新目錄清單的問題也已修復。⟦跟多庫房聯外通道管制一樣，以往只鎖定主倉庫，現在副庫全數列入許可清單，巡檢推車也一律在隔離防護網內作業。⟧

自動執行的 Sapling 指令（快照與工作階段工作樹）全數移入沙盒內執行；工作階段工作樹也會拒絕在尚未信任的工作區執行 Sapling。無特權容器中工作樹（平行開多份副本的功能）的建立與清理都維持沙盒化；EdenFS 簽出中的 `sl`、`hg` 必須透過啟動器並停用沙盒，才能存取 Eden 狀態；原生沙盒不再開放 Eden 檔案系統與通訊端。
body.en:
When working on large projects spanning multiple repositories, the security boundaries of file tools and version control commands are critical. Shell commands can now write under every workspace root a client grants with `workspaceRoots`, no longer restricted to the primary root. Both shell and file tools refuse access to roots that no longer resolve to their recorded locations. An issue where degraded session recovery lost the latest workspace root list has also been fixed. ⟦Consider access control across multiple warehouses: while only the main building used to be guarded, auxiliary facilities are now fully added to the allowlist, and inspection carts operate strictly within an isolated security perimeter.⟧

Sapling commands executed automatically (workspace snapshots and session worktrees) now run entirely inside the sandbox. Session worktrees also refuse to run Sapling in a workspace that has not been trusted yet. Worktree (a feature that lets you open multiple parallel copies of a project) creation and cleanup remain sandboxed inside unprivileged containers. On EdenFS checkouts, `sl` and `hg` must go through the launcher with the sandbox disabled to access Eden state. The native sandbox no longer grants access to the Eden filesystem or sockets.

items.original:
Security: Shell and file tools refuse a workspace root that no longer resolves to its recorded location instead of following it to a new target
Security: The Sapling commands the harness runs for you (workspace snapshots, session worktrees) now run inside the sandbox instead of directly on your machine, and session worktrees refuse to run Sapling in a workspace you have not trusted
Shell commands can write under every workspace root a session protocol client grants with `workspaceRoots`, not only the primary root
On EdenFS checkouts, `sl` and `hg` commands need the launcher (sandbox disabled) to reach Eden state; the native sandbox no longer grants Eden filesystem or socket access
Fixed degraded session recovery losing the latest workspace root set
Worktree creation and cleanup stay sandboxed in unprivileged containers, using an empty read-only process view where the container refuses a fresh one

title.zh-TW: 沙盒啟動異常即時警示，中斷流程不再殘留半成品
title.en: Sandbox Startup Anomalies Alert Promptly, Preventing Interrupted Flows from Leaving Half-Baked Sessions

body.zh-TW: 啟動指令列工具時，若背景安全防護失靈卻毫無聲息，很容易在無保護的狀態下執行危險指令。現在若設定的 Bubblewrap 路徑無法使用，啟動時會恢復顯示沙盒不可用的警告；若設定的 Linux 沙盒輔助程式路徑無法使用，則會明確報錯並停止啟動，不再靜默改以非沙盒模式啟動。⟦恰似汽車發動時的儀表板自我檢測，以前故障通知可能被藏起來，現在該亮的警示燈會亮起，遇到必須阻止發動的故障才鎖住點火。⟧啟動程序如果在中途意外遭到中斷，Muse 也不會再留下只建立到一半的工作階段。
body.en: When launching command-line tools, silent failures in background security defenses make it easy to run dangerous commands without protection. Now, if the configured Bubblewrap path is unusable, startup resumes showing a warning that the sandbox is unavailable. If the configured Linux sandbox helper path is unusable, startup fails with a clear error and halts, rather than silently falling back to unsandboxed mode. ⟦Much like an automobile dashboard running a self-test at ignition, warning lights now illuminate instead of hiding trouble notices, locking the ignition only when encountering faults that must prevent engine start.⟧ If the startup process is interrupted mid-flight, Muse also no longer leaves behind a partially created session.

items.original:
Startup warns again when the configured Bubblewrap path is unusable instead of hiding the sandbox-unavailable notice
Keep interrupted startup from leaving a partially created session
Startup fails with a clear error when the configured Linux sandbox helper path is unusable instead of silently starting unsandboxed

title.zh-TW: 對話倒帶支援邊界狀態，壓縮後與儲存中斷皆可回溯
title.en: Chat Rewinds Handle Edge States, Restoring History Even After Compaction or Save Failures

body.zh-TW:
若想放棄先前的對話走向並回溯到前幾輪，一旦遇到儲存異常或壓縮紀錄，以前常會被整張拒絕。現在對話倒帶（rewind）功能在各種極端邊界狀態下都能順利執行。如果你想倒帶至失敗或結尾未儲存（例如磁碟滿載）的輪次之前，操作已能正常生效；永遠無法倒帶的輪次會直接標記為無法使用，不再出現在選項中。⟦猶如卡帶錄音機倒帶，碰上磁帶接合處或部分雜音段落不再咬帶卡死，而是順暢跳過損壞點並精確停在想重錄的時間點。⟧

如果對話已經過上下文壓縮，或是儲存檢查點時前一輪仍在執行，確認後倒帶也不會再遭拒絕。即使遇到某一輪開頭因磁碟已滿未能寫入，現在依然能執行倒帶，流程會自動略過該受損輪次並主動提示一次。
body.en:
When you want to abandon a conversational path and step back to previous turns, encountering storage errors or compacted history used to trigger outright refusals. Now the chat rewind feature works smoothly across various edge cases. Rewinding to before a turn that failed, or whose end could not be saved (for example on a full disk), now succeeds instead of being refused. Turns that can never be rewound are clearly shown as unavailable instead of being offered in the options. ⟦An audio cassette deck rewinding past tape splices or noisy segments no longer snags and jams, smoothly skipping over damaged spots to stop precisely where re-recording should begin.⟧

If a conversation has undergone context compaction, or if the preceding turn was still running when a checkpoint was saved, rewinding is no longer refused after you confirm it. Even when the start of a turn could not be written to disk because storage ran out, the chat can still be rewound, and the process automatically leaves out the damaged turn while Muse informs you once.

items.original:
Rewinding to before a turn that failed, or whose end could not be saved (for example on a full disk), now works instead of every attempt being refused, and a turn that can never be rewound is shown as unavailable instead of offered
Rewinding to a turn after one that was still running when the chat saved a checkpoint now works, instead of every such rewind being refused after you confirm it
Rewinding to a turn after the conversation was compacted now works, instead of every such rewind being refused
A chat where the start of one turn could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) can be rewound again; the rewind leaves out that one turn, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿載中斷單輪寫入，對話自動隔離壞輪以保留進度
title.en: Full Disks Halting Turn Writes Isolate Damaged Turns Automatically to Preserve Chat Progress

body.zh-TW:
磁碟空間偶爾用盡時，若剛好卡在某一輪剛啟動的寫入瞬間，以前重開軟體很容易連帶丟失後續的所有紀錄。現在不論在終端機應用還是透過 Muse 工作階段伺服器開啟的對話，某輪開頭若因磁碟滿載未能寫入，重開後該輪會被安全擱置並提示一次，不會再遺失後續檢查點。⟦好似活頁筆記本有一張紙沾滿墨水，管理員將污損那頁夾入附錄袋，整本筆記依然能正常翻閱、影印裝訂與接續書寫。⟧

哪怕同一輪中接連遺失工具結果與下一個工具呼叫的兩次儲存，現在也能順利重新開啟對話。這類對話也能進行分岔（fork）並開啟側邊對話，新對話會略過未寫入的輪次並提示一次。分岔子對話自身遇到相同寫入問題，重開後也會略過該輪、提示一次，並能繼續執行。
body.en:
When disk storage runs out right at the start of writing a turn, restarting the application previously risked losing all subsequent history. Now, whether in the terminal app or in chats opened through the Muse session server, if the start of a turn cannot be written due to a full disk, that turn is safely set aside upon restarting and reported once without losing later checkpoints. ⟦Just as a loose-leaf binder handles an ink-stained page by filing the ruined sheet into an appendix pouch, the entire notebook remains open for reading, copying, and continuing notes as usual.⟧

Even if a chat loses two saves in the same turn (a tool result followed by the next tool call), it can now be reopened cleanly. Such chats can also be forked and can open side chats; the new chat skips the unwritten turn and informs you once. If a forked sub-chat encounters the same write failure itself, reopening also leaves out that turn, reports it once, and allows you to continue execution.

items.original:
In the terminal app, a chat where the start of one turn could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) no longer loses every later checkpoint after a restart; that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once
A chat that lost two saves in one turn on a full disk (a tool result, then the next tool call) can be reopened again; the affected turn is set aside instead of blocking the whole chat
In apps that open chats through the Muse session server, a chat where the start of one turn could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) no longer loses later checkpoints after it is reopened; that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once
A chat where the start of one turn could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) can be forked and can open a side chat again; the new chat leaves out that one turn, and Muse says so once
A forked chat where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) can be reopened and continued again; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 儲存異常具備明確錯誤與自動復原，排除硬體問題即可接續進度
title.en: Explicit Errors and Automatic Recovery for Storage Failures Resume Progress Once Hardware Issues Resolve

body.zh-TW:
遇上硬碟空間短缺或偶發的讀寫錯誤時，儲存失敗若只會無窮重試，會讓操作卡住。現在回覆或子代理人結果無法寫入時，Muse 短暫重試後會顯示錯誤，說明為何拒收新訊息。此時執行 `/new`、`/clear` 或其他建立新工作階段的操作、設定本機模型、更換供應商金鑰，都會立即顯示「saving failed … retrying automatically」，對話復原後可重試原指令。⟦好比投幣機卡住，以前按鍵沒反應，現在會亮出故障提示，卡住的原因排除後便能繼續使用。⟧

背景儲存被短暫讀寫錯誤中斷而未重試，或檔案暫時無法開啟、讀取，問題排除後都會恢復儲存，不必重啟。檢查點連續兩次寫入中斷時，對話與提醒輔助程式會清理半寫入檔案，再恢復儲存。磁碟滿載時未存下的工具結果與其他對話紀錄，會在工作階段下一步、空間足夠時補存。
body.en:
When facing disk space shortages or occasional read/write errors, save failures that retry indefinitely can freeze operations. Now, when a reply or subagent result cannot be written, Muse retries briefly and then displays an error explaining why new messages are refused. At this point, running `/new`, `/clear`, or other actions that start a new session, configuring a local model, or swapping a provider key immediately displays "saving failed … retrying automatically", allowing you to retry the command once the chat recovers. ⟦A coin-operated machine that jams used to leave buttons completely unresponsive; now it displays an error notice, and once the blockage clears you can continue using it.⟧

When background saving is interrupted by a brief read/write error and never retried, or when a file temporarily cannot be opened or read, saving resumes once the issue clears without requiring a restart. When checkpoint writes are interrupted twice in a row, the chat and reminder helper clean up the half-written file before resuming saving. Tool results and other chat records that failed to save while the disk was full are saved again at the session's next step once sufficient space is available.

items.original:
When a finished reply or a subagent result cannot be saved, Muse retries briefly, then shows a clear error that says why new messages are refused instead of retrying silently every second
When a chat is stuck retrying a save that failed, `/new`, `/clear` and other new sessions from it, local-model setup and a provider key swap now fail at once with the "saving failed … retrying automatically" message instead of waiting quietly or saving a rejection, and the same command works once the chat recovers
When a background save to the chat file is cut short by a brief I/O error and never retried, the chat goes back to saving its progress once the problem clears, instead of staying unable to save until restart
When one save to the chat file fails because the file could not be opened or read (a brief I/O error), the chat goes back to saving its progress as soon as the problem clears, instead of staying unable to save until restart
A tool result or other chat record whose save failed while the disk was full is saved again at the session's next step if there is room by then, so a restart after that keeps it
When saving a checkpoint is interrupted twice in a row by a brief I/O error, the chat (and a reminder helper) now cleans up the half-written save and keeps saving its progress once the problem clears, instead of staying unable to save until it is reopened

title.zh-TW: 工作階段分岔更加穩固，精確保留指定輪次並抵抗高負載
title.en: Session Forking Gains Resilience, Accurately Preserving Target Turns Under Heavy Load

body.zh-TW:
想在探索新想法時從舊對話分岔出獨立分支，若負載一高就噴出內部錯誤，會打斷思考。現在分岔（fork）與側邊對話在高負載下不再報出內部錯誤；從較早輪次分岔時，會保留至指定輪次，包含該輪。⟦跟在影印室調借檔案一樣，以前挑好頁碼卻被拒絕複印，現在會連同指定那頁一起裝訂，人多時也不再無端報警。⟧部分壓縮過的對話與分岔的分岔，仍可能拒絕截斷或從較晚輪次分岔；舊工作階段仍開啟時，也仍拒絕不保留任何輪次的截斷。

即使過去曾遇上磁碟滿載導致工具呼叫未寫入，只要工具結果已寫入且後續有新檢查點，就能進行分岔或建立側邊對話。透過協定分岔工作階段時，也不會再偶發出現新工作階段已被使用的假性衝突。
body.en:
Branching an independent exploration from an existing conversation can disrupt thinking if heavy system loads trigger internal errors. Forking and side chats now handle heavy loads without throwing internal errors, and forking from an earlier turn preserves history up to and including that specific turn. ⟦Photocopying borrowed files in a print room used to reject requests after pages were selected; now it binds through the specified page, and high foot traffic no longer triggers false alarms.⟧ Certain compacted sessions and forks of forks may still refuse truncation or forking from later turns, and truncations that retain no turns from an older session are still rejected while that session remains open.

Even when a previously full disk prevented a tool call from writing to disk, forking or starting a side chat remains fully supported as long as the tool result landed and a later checkpoint exists. Forking a session over the session protocol also eliminates intermittent false conflict reports claiming the new session is already in use.

items.original:
A chat whose tool call could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) while its result was written can now be forked or given a side chat after a later checkpoint, instead of the fork failing
Fork and side chat no longer fail with an internal error when the system is under load
Forking a session at an earlier turn keeps exactly the turns up to that turn instead of refusing the cut (some compacted sessions and forks of forks still refuse the cut or fork from a later turn, and a cut that keeps no turns of an older session still refuses while that session is open)
Forking a session over the session protocol no longer intermittently reports the new session is already in use

title.zh-TW: 側邊對話寫入隔離，支援首次手動壓縮並相容外接工具
title.en: Side Chats Isolate Write Failures, Support Initial Manual Compaction, and Ensure External Tool Compatibility

body.zh-TW:
開啟側邊對話來驗證額外想法時，若副視窗的存檔失敗波及主對話，會讓人十分困擾。現在當側邊對話因磁碟滿載等原因寫入失敗時，主對話依然能持續儲存進度，且待問題排除後依然能正常分岔，不會再被牽連卡死。側邊對話在儲存檢查點後，也能完整保留原本的對話內容。⟦如同料理時在旁側切菜板切碎配料，副盤即便堆滿碎屑也能就地壓實整理，即使不慎翻落也不會弄髒正在主爐上熬煮的主湯鍋。⟧

側邊對話的功能也更加齊全：現在第一次執行手動壓縮已能順利運作，即使工作階段恢復後也沒問題。若專案配置了 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定），剛恢復對話後立刻輸入 `/side`，不會再阻擋後續訊息送達模型；由 `/side` 開啟的側邊對話會在不帶 MCP 工具的輕量環境下獨立運行。
body.en:
Opening a side chat to test alternative ideas becomes frustrating when saving failures in the secondary view cascade into the main chat. Now, when a side chat write fails due to full disks or similar faults, the main chat continues saving progress and can still be forked once the issue clears without being dragged down. Side chats also fully preserve the original conversation after saving a checkpoint. ⟦Chopping ingredients on a side cutting board keeps the side prep neat even when scrap piles up, and an accidental spill never fouls the main soup simmering on the primary burner.⟧

Side chat capabilities are also more complete: the first manual compaction now runs smoothly, including after resuming a session. If a project configures MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools), entering `/side` right after resuming a chat no longer blocks subsequent messages from reaching the model. Side chats launched via `/side` run independently in a lightweight environment without MCP tools.

items.original:
When one write to a side chat's file fails (for example on a full disk), the main chat keeps saving its progress and can still be forked once the problem clears, instead of staying unable to save until restart
The first manual compaction in a side chat now works, including after resuming it
With MCP servers configured, using `/side` before your first message (for example right after resuming) no longer stops every later message before it reaches the model; a side chat you open with `/side` now runs without MCP tools
Side chats retain the original conversation after a checkpoint

title.zh-TW: 上下文壓縮失敗保全對話，磁碟回穩無需重啟即刻恢復
title.en: Failed Context Compaction Preserves Conversations, Resuming Instantly Once Storage Recovers Without Restarts

body.zh-TW:
當對話內容變得非常冗長時，背景如果嘗試壓縮上下文卻不幸失敗，最怕整個請求就此中斷。現在即使壓縮過程遭遇失敗，Muse 依然會保留完整的上下文，讓長篇請求能順暢地繼續執行下去，不再中途斷線。⟦宛如整理過季衣物時壓縮袋拉鍊卡住，收納箱不會直接把所有衣物丟出門外，而是維持原狀讓你繼續擺放，等袋子修好就能直接抽氣封口。⟧

這項改進也修復了與儲存壓力相關的連鎖問題。過去若因磁碟已滿導致回覆或一般工具結果未能寫入，往往需要重開軟體才能恢復檢查點儲存；現在只要磁碟空間恢復，壓縮檢查點就能立刻接續運作。在回覆中途執行壓縮後，終端機介面也不會再因為過期的阻塞讀數，誤觸第二次無意義的自動壓縮。
body.en:
When conversations grow exceptionally long, background attempts to compact context that fail risk terminating the entire request. Even if compaction fails, Muse preserves the full context so that long requests continue running smoothly without dropping mid-stream. ⟦When a compression bag zipper snags during seasonal wardrobe sorting, the storage trunk keeps holding your clothes in place rather than dumping them outside, letting you resume vacuum sealing the moment the bag is fixed.⟧

This improvement also addresses cascading issues related to storage pressure. Previously, when replies or ordinary tool results failed to write due to a full disk, restarting the software was often required to restore checkpoint saves; now, compaction checkpoints resume working immediately as soon as disk space clears. After a mid-reply compaction, the terminal interface also no longer fires a needless second auto-compaction caused by a stale Blocked pressure reading.

items.original:
Keep long requests running with their full context when compaction fails
After a reply or an ordinary tool result could not be saved to a full disk, compaction checkpoints work again without restarting the chat
After a mid-reply compaction, the TUI no longer fires a needless second auto-compaction on the stale Blocked pressure reading

title.zh-TW: 工作流程狀態清晰透明，缺席模型自動備援且中斷指引明確
title.en: Workflow Status Remains Transparent with Automatic Model Fallbacks and Clear Interruption Guidance

body.zh-TW:
在多代理人協同作業的 Workflow（工作流程）中，某個環節暫停或中止，以前介面很容易跳出內部錯誤。現在流程暫停或停止而無法啟動代理人時，復原提示列與失敗項目會說明原因，並建議「若仍需要請重新啟動 Workflow」，不再誤報內部錯誤或要求填寫 `/feedback`。⟦恰如產線調度站遇到技師請假，會改派現有師傅並註記；停機時看板也會說明如何重啟，不再誤鳴全廠警報。⟧

若指定模型未在目前工作階段提供，呼叫會改用工作階段的模型，主代理人會告知各次呼叫用了哪個模型。子代理人切換模型或喚醒遭拒的通知，即使下一輪在開始前被取消，再下一輪仍會送達。帶有 `stop: true` 離開工作階段時會先中止流程，避免恢復時重問復原。寫入失敗而結束的流程，清單列會先顯示失敗或取消結果，再於通常寬限期後移除。
body.en:
In multi-agent collaborative workflows, pausing or stopping a step previously caused the interface to surface internal errors. When a workflow pause or stop prevents an agent call from starting, the recovery line and failed row now explain the reason and suggest "Start the Workflow again if it is still needed.", no longer reporting an internal error or asking for a `/feedback` report. ⟦An assembly line dispatch desk with a technician on leave reassigns tasks to an available specialist with a clear note; during a stoppage, the display board explains how to restart instead of blaring an erroneous plant-wide alarm.⟧

If a requested model is not offered in the current session, the call falls back to the session's model, and the main agent informs you which calls ran on which model. Notifications about a subagent switching models or having a wake-up refused still arrive on the subsequent turn, even if the immediately following turn was cancelled before starting. Leaving a session with `stop: true` stops the running workflow before handing over, preventing resume prompts from asking about recovery. For workflows that end after a durable fact write fails, the bottom work list displays the failed or cancelled result before clearing after the usual grace period.

items.original:
When a Workflow pause or stop keeps an agent call from starting, its Recovery line and its failed row now say so instead of calling it an internal error and asking for a `/feedback` report
A Workflow agent call whose Agent Definition asks for a model this session doesn't offer now runs on the session's model instead of failing, and the main agent tells you which calls ran on which model
`session/leave` with `stop: true` now stops a running workflow before it hands the session over, so resuming the session no longer offers to recover the workflow you stopped
When a Workflow pause or stop keeps an agent call from starting, its Recovery line and its failed row now end with what you can do: "Start the Workflow again if it is still needed."
A workflow that ended after its durable fact write failed no longer stays listed as running forever in the bottom work list; its row now shows the failed or cancelled result and clears after the usual grace
If a Workflow subagent switches model or has a wake-up refused and you cancel your next turn before it starts, the turn after it still tells you about it

title.zh-TW: 工作流程個別呼叫可單獨失敗，持續儲存異常仍會停止流程
title.en: Individual Workflow Calls Can Fail in Isolation, While Persistent Storage Errors Still Halt Runs

body.zh-TW:
執行複雜的多代理人工作流程時，磁碟短暫寫滿很容易導致整串任務直接報銷。現在新代理人呼叫的啟動狀態重試一次仍無法寫入時，只讓該次呼叫失敗並說明原因，其餘 Workflow（工作流程）繼續執行。若是另一代理人的啟動狀態無法確認已存檔，也只中止當次呼叫；但儲存若仍未恢復，流程會在下一次儲存時停止。⟦好似接力賽有跑者臨時退場，以前整場直接取消，現在先處理該棒；若賽道仍無法使用，後續仍得停賽。⟧

背景輔助工作階段啟動時寫入失敗，問題排除後能恢復儲存與檢查點。磁碟滿載使流程取消後，遲到的背景結果不再卡死檢查點；開啟新對話也不會重試舊對話未存檔的結束動作。流程結果存檔失敗後又呼叫其他工具，對話在重啟後仍能於同一應用程式工作階段中開啟。
body.en:
When running complex multi-agent workflows, briefly running out of disk space could easily scrap an entire series of tasks. Now, when the startup state of a new agent call cannot be written even after one retry, only that specific call fails with a plain reason, while the rest of the workflow continues running. If another agent's startup state cannot be confirmed as saved, only that invocation aborts; however, if storage has still not recovered, the workflow halts at its next save. ⟦A relay race runner withdrawing unexpectedly used to cancel the entire event, but officials now isolate that single leg; if the track itself remains unusable, the subsequent race still halts.⟧

When a write fails as a background helper session starts, subsequent saves and checkpoints resume once the issue clears. After a full disk cancels a workflow, late-arriving background results no longer freeze checkpoints, and opening a new chat will not retry an unsaved run ending from the previous chat. If a chat fails to save a workflow result and then invokes another tool, it can still be reopened in the same application session following a restart.

items.original:
A chat whose Workflow result could not be saved (for example on a full disk) and that then ran another tool now reopens in the same app session after a restart, instead of failing to open
When a write to a background helper session's file fails once (for example on a full disk) right after it starts, its later writes and checkpoints go through once the problem clears, instead of staying refused until restart
After a full disk, starting a new chat no longer retries the previous chat's unsaved run ending in the new chat
When a brief storage failure, such as a full disk, keeps the session log from saving a new Workflow agent call's start even after its one retry, only that call now fails, with a plain reason, and the rest of the Workflow keeps running; before, the whole Workflow ended
After a full disk cancelled a workflow run, a later background result on that run no longer stops checkpoints until a restart
When another agent's start could not be confirmed as saved just as a Workflow starts a new agent call, that call now fails on its own with a plain reason; while session storage is still failing, the Workflow still stops at its next save

title.zh-TW: 子代理人支援即時記錄檢視，狀態回報與中斷復原更穩固
title.en: Subagents Support Live Transcript Views, Resilient Status Reporting, and Reliable Crash Recovery

body.zh-TW:
當主代理人派出子代理人平行處理子任務時，掌握它們的內部進度與即時動態往往是最關鍵的一步。現在點開子代理人的詳細檢視時，Muse 會直接自該子代理人的獨立工作階段載入記錄稿，並在開啟期間維持即時連線更新。當你向執行中的子代理人傳送筆記時，一旦對方成功接收，介面便會立即顯示「已送達」（Delivered）狀態列，確認訊息已交到子代理人手中。⟦猶如野外探勘指揮部連線隨身攝影機，畫面即時連線並在便籤傳達時打上已送達標記，隊員通訊中斷時誠實回報失聯狀態，絕不擅自猜測或盲目重發危險爆破指令。⟧

異常復原機制也變得更加保險。如果子代理人遭遇當機，復原程序會把遺失的工具結果如實標記為未知，不再危險地自動重新呼叫。若要求停止子代理人的操作在生效瞬間被中斷，下次開啟工作階段時會自動補齊停止紀錄，就算寫入受阻也能照常開啟並於後續重試。
body.en:
When a primary agent dispatches subagents to handle subtasks in parallel, tracking internal progress and live activity is essential. Opening a subagent's detail view now loads the transcript directly from the child's own session and keeps it live while open. When sending notes to a running subagent, once the recipient picks them up, the interface immediately displays a Delivered row confirming delivery. ⟦Field expedition headquarters linking into body cameras maintains a live feed and stamps notes as delivered upon receipt; when a team member loses signal, it honestly reports the disconnect rather than guessing or blindly reissuing dangerous blasting orders.⟧

Error recovery mechanisms are also safer. If a subagent crashes, recovery procedures faithfully report missing tool results as unknown instead of automatically and dangerously rerunning calls. If a subagent stop is interrupted right after taking effect, reopening the session automatically completes the stop record, opening successfully even if writing is blocked and retrying on the subsequent launch.

items.original:
Subagent crash recovery reports missing tool results as unknown without automatically rerunning the calls
Opening a subagent's detail view now loads the child's transcript from the child's own session and keeps it live while open
A subagent stop that was interrupted right after it took effect no longer leaves that subagent stuck: the next open completes the stop's record, and if that record cannot be written the session still opens and the next open retries
Notes sent to a running subagent now show a Delivered row once the child picks them up

title.zh-TW: 背景任務精準喚醒工作階段，通知管理與狀態監聽更可靠
title.en: Background Tasks Accurately Wake Sessions, Improving Notification Controls and State Watching

body.zh-TW:
把費時的建置或測試丟到背景執行時，最需要的是在它跑完的瞬間能即時喚醒工作階段。現在當背景任務結束時，處於閒置狀態的工作階段能可靠地被喚醒；若任務完成時工作階段正好在忙碌，也會在當前阻擋的執行步驟告一段落後立刻喚醒。⟦就像廚房為長效烘焙裝上智慧響鈴，出爐時精準提醒主廚，即便主廚正忙著切菜也會在切完當下立刻提示，點選手機通知就能立刻關閉烤箱。⟧

背景控制與目標模式也更具彈性。從系統通知中心直接點擊停止背景工作現在能順暢執行，不會再出現找不到任務的錯誤。在以目標為導向（Goal）的工作階段中，會透過變更監聽器等待外部工作，不再看似陷入死當。即使偶發的儲存錯誤導致某個背景任務的儲存狀態未能確認，工作階段的定期檢查點依然能持續寫入，不會因此停擺至重啟。
body.en:
When offloading time-consuming builds or tests to the background, sessions must wake the moment those runs finish. Idle sessions now reliably wake when a background task completes; if the session is busy when completion occurs, it wakes as soon as the currently blocking run settles. ⟦A smart timer installed for long-running kitchen baking alerts the chef precisely when the oven finishes, notifying them right after their prep work wraps up if their hands are currently full, and tapping the phone notification immediately shuts off the oven.⟧

Background management and goal modes are also more flexible. Stopping background work directly from notifications now succeeds without reporting that the task was not found. Goal sessions waiting on external work rely on a change watcher instead of appearing hung. Even if a one-time storage error leaves a background task save unconfirmed, periodic session checkpoints continue landing instead of being refused until restart.

items.original:
Sessions wake once the blocking run settles after a background task finishes while the session is busy
Goal sessions waiting on external work wait on a change watcher instead of appearing stopped
Stopping background work from a notification now works instead of reporting it was not found
Idle sessions reliably wake when a background task finishes
After a one-time storage error leaves a background task's save unconfirmed, the session's periodic context checkpoints keep landing instead of being refused until restart

title.zh-TW: 伺服模式支援啟動預設集，連線釋放與掛鉤排程更完備
title.en: Server Mode Supports Run Presets, Clean Connection Teardown, and Hook Scheduling

body.zh-TW:
透過 `muse serve` 架設工作階段伺服器時，快速套用預設組態並妥善處理連線退場是穩定運作的核心。現在啟動主機可加上 `--preset` 挑選執行預設集；命令列設定的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）如 `-c hooks.…` 也會確實執行，不再被靜默丟棄。⟦好似旅館櫃台換了退房流程，以前回覆送不出去就一直占住房間，現在會按期限處理，打烊也不必翻遍歷史名冊。⟧

`session/leave` 的確認回覆若無法送達，會在期限到期時判定失敗，不再卡住工作階段直到連線關閉。逾時後在同主機讀取，執行程序停止前會回報仍在停止，停止後即可再次讀取。臨時主機重放原 `session/start` 時會回傳原確認回覆，不會重新建立已移除的工作階段。關閉主機或離開時也不再重讀整份歷史。
body.en:
When hosting a session server with `muse serve`, applying preset configurations and managing clean connection exits are core to operational stability. Starting a host now supports `--preset` to select a run preset, and hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) configured from the command line like `-c hooks.…` execute reliably instead of being silently dropped. ⟦Front desk checkout at a hotel used to tie up rooms indefinitely whenever a departure notice failed to transmit; now requests resolve at their deadline, and closing down for the night no longer requires re-reading the entire guest registry.⟧

When an accepted reply for `session/leave` cannot reach the client, it fails at its deadline instead of holding the session until the connection closes. If a timeout occurs, reading that session on the same host reports that it is still stopping until the runtime terminates, after which it can be read again. Replaying the original `session/start` on an ephemeral host returns the original acknowledgement without recreating the removed session. Leaving a session or shutting down the host no longer rereads the entire chat history.

items.original:
Choose a run preset when starting a session host with `muse serve --preset`
After a `session/leave` times out, reading that session on the same host works again once its runtime has stopped; until then the read reports that the session is still stopping
A `session/leave` whose accepted reply cannot reach the client now fails at its deadline, instead of holding the session until the connection closes
Hooks set with `muse serve -c hooks.…` now run in served sessions instead of being silently dropped
On an ephemeral `muse serve` host, replaying the original `session/start` of a session that `session/leave` released now answers the original acknowledgement without bringing the removed session back
In `muse serve`, leaving a session and shutting the host down no longer reread the whole chat history to report its final position

title.zh-TW: 遠端重傳不再衝突，受損磁碟檢視恢復時重建完整歷史
title.en: Remote Retries Avoid Conflicts, Rebuilding Full History from Logs When Disk Views Break

body.zh-TW:
利用遠端通訊協定操作 Muse 時，斷線重連或磁碟檢視受損常導致對話狀態不同步。現在重啟伺服器後，以相同指令識別碼重傳已完成輪次的 `turn/start` 具備冪等性（重送仍得到同一結果），會回傳原回覆而非衝突；畫面過時而顯示閒置時，提示詞會導入進行中的背景傳遞，不再重複執行。⟦如同銀行轉帳，以前斷線重送可能報錯，現在同一交易序號會調出原收據；存摺磨損也能當場補齊，不必再跑一趟。⟧

若磁碟檢視受損，如 `HEAD.json` 毀損，恢復時會直接從工作階段記錄檔重建完整歷史，不必再次開啟。啟用目標（goal）的工作階段會持續儲存檢查點加速恢復；歷史畫面會準確顯示背景終端機完成標記。無記錄模式下，啟動子代理人後，待核准事項與待回答問題也都仍可讀。
body.en:
When operating Muse over remote protocols, dropped connections or damaged disk views often cause out-of-sync session states. Now, after restarting the server, resending `turn/start` for a completed turn with the same command ID is idempotent (producing the same result when resent), returning the original reply instead of a conflict. When a stale view appears idle, new prompts steer into active background delivery instead of triggering duplicate runs. ⟦Bank wire transfers used to risk errors on reconnecting after a dropped connection, whereas identical transaction IDs now pull up the original receipt; worn passbooks can also be reconciled immediately without requiring an extra visit.⟧

When disk views are damaged, such as a corrupt `HEAD.json`, resuming rebuilds the full history directly from the session log without requiring reopening. Sessions using a goal continuously save checkpoints to accelerate resume, and history views accurately display completion markers for background terminals. In `--no-session-log` mode, pending approvals and questions remain readable after launching subagents.

items.original:
Pending approvals and questions in `muse serve --no-session-log` sessions stay readable after the agent starts a subagent
Over `muse serve`, resending a finished turn's `turn/start` with the same command id after a restart returns its original reply instead of a command id conflict
A prompt sent while the session view is stale-idle steers into the active background delivery over the session protocol instead of starting a duplicate fresh run
Sessions served by `muse serve` that use a goal keep saving context checkpoints, so they resume quickly again
Resume and history show the finished marker for background terminal completions served over the session protocol, matching the live view
A `muse serve` chat whose saved view on disk is damaged or unreadable (for example a torn `HEAD.json`, a missing journal file, or history a newer build wrote) is rebuilt from its session log while it is being resumed, so that resume shows the whole history instead of no history, and the chat never needs reopening

title.zh-TW: 跨版本工作階段相容讀取，對話記錄零星破損仍可檢視
title.en: Cross-Version Session Compatibility and Viewing for Partially Damaged Chat Logs

body.zh-TW:
團隊成員使用不同版本或對話紀錄意外受損時，檔案無法開啟常會阻斷排查。現在若對話記錄檔中間有遺漏或無法讀取的損壞行，只要對話從未壓縮，在支援協定的應用程式中仍能開啟檢視。介面會展示所有可讀內容，並在損壞處標註提示，不再擋住整份對話；不過仍暫時拒絕繼續發話或分岔。⟦恰似圖書館調閱古老典籍，以前一行蟲蛀就拒絕借閱，現在館方會夾上提示卡，讓讀者閱覽其餘篇章。⟧

當較新版本在工作階段持久化記錄中加入新欄位成員時，舊版依然能讀取，不再因未知成員而整體失敗。包含已完成子代理人接續紀錄的對話，需要相容版本才能開啟。曾因權限歷史遺失或受損而重設權限的對話，舊版也無法開啟，須更新 Muse；其他對話不受影響。
body.en:
When team members run different versions or chat logs are unexpectedly damaged, the inability to open files often blocks troubleshooting. Now, if a saved chat log has a missing or unreadable damaged line in the middle, it still opens for reading in apps that support the protocol, provided the chat was never compacted. The interface displays everything readable with a notice at the damaged spot instead of blocking the entire chat, though continuing or forking such a chat is still temporarily refused. ⟦In an archival reading room, a single moth-eaten line once barred access to an entire ancient volume, but staff now insert an advisory slip so readers can view the rest.⟧

When a newer version adds a new field member to durable session records, older builds keep reading them instead of failing entirely over unknown members. Chats containing saved continuations of finished subagents require a compatible version to open. Older builds also cannot open a chat whose permissions were reset because part of its saved permission history was lost or damaged, requiring a Muse update; other chats remain unaffected.

items.original:
Chats containing saved continuations of finished subagents require a compatible app update; older versions cannot read them
An older Muse build cannot open a chat whose permissions were reset because part of its saved permission history was lost or damaged; update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
Older builds keep reading durable session records after a newer build adds a member, instead of failing the whole session read
A chat that was never compacted and whose saved log has an unreadable or missing line in the middle now opens for reading in apps that use the session protocol, showing everything that can be read with a notice at the spot, instead of refusing the whole chat; continuing or forking such a chat is still refused for now

title.zh-TW: 終端機介面雜訊過濾，金鑰存取逾時保護與錯誤去重
title.en: Terminal Noise Filtering, Keychain Timeout Protection, and Error Deduplication

body.zh-TW:
在終端機環境中連續工作時，最怕系統噴出一連串重複的錯誤訊息或在離開時被內部記錄洗版。現在當設定、環境或步數上限等同一錯誤連續阻擋兩輪對話，且兩輪之間未顯示其他內容時，工作階段執行期間只會顯示一次。退出文字介面（TUI）時，內部的清理與關閉診斷訊息也會自動導流至本機日誌檔。⟦就像音響系統內建抑噪電路，唱針跳針時會自動過濾重複噪音，按下電源開關時安靜切斷電源，不會在喇叭中留下刺耳的關機爆音。⟧

在 macOS 上若鑰匙圈（Keychain）無回應，程式會在 5 秒後停止等待並提示登入資料仍已儲存，且執行 `muse --help` 時不再等待鑰匙圈。當快取（本機暫存）缺少指定模型時，背景只會重新整理一次模型清單；若 `/feedback` 上傳失敗，介面也會顯示伺服器回傳的具體原因。
body.en:
Working continuously in a terminal environment makes repeated error cascades or exit screen clutter from internal logs especially frustrating. When the same configuration, environment, or step-limit error stops two consecutive dialogue turns with nothing displayed between them, it now appears only once while the session runs. Quitting the text user interface (TUI) also automatically redirects internal cleanup and shutdown diagnostics to the local log file. ⟦Built-in noise suppression inside a sound system automatically filters repeated noise when a needle skips and cuts power quietly at the switch, leaving no harsh shutdown pop in the speakers.⟧

On macOS, if the Keychain stops responding, the program stops waiting after 5 seconds and notes that your login is still saved, and running `muse --help` no longer waits on the Keychain. When the chosen model is missing from the cache, the background refreshes the model catalog only once. If a `/feedback` upload fails, the interface also displays the specific reason returned by the server.

items.original:
The TUI refreshes the model catalog once in the background when the chosen model is missing from the cache, instead of starting a second refresh
On macOS, Muse Code no longer freezes when the Keychain stops answering: it stops waiting after 5 seconds and says your login is still saved, and `muse --help` no longer waits on the Keychain
Failed `/feedback` uploads now show the reason returned by the server instead of only the status code
Quitting the TUI no longer prints internal cleanup or shutdown diagnostics to the terminal; they now go to the local diagnostic log
When the same configuration, environment or step-limit error stops two turns back to back with nothing shown between them, it now appears once while the session runs, as it already does after a resume

title.zh-TW: SDK 配套套件自動安裝，重複設定去重以加速工作階段恢復
title.en: SDK Companion Package Auto-Installation and Setup Deduplication for Faster Session Resumes

body.zh-TW:
使用 Python 開發 Muse 應用程式時，若安裝完套件卻缺少核心依賴，常會不知道從何查起。現在執行 `pip install muse-code-sdk` 會自動安裝配套的 wire-types 套件，讓全新環境能執行 `import muse_code`；SDK 應用程式也能將 Replace 啟動的新輪次正確辨識為執行中輪次（activeTurn）。⟦好似選購組合家具開箱，以前得另找零件，現在工具與螺絲一次附齊；重複安裝規格也濃縮成通用目錄，包裹更輕巧，組裝更迅速。⟧

長時間工作階段會將重複設定區塊濃縮只存一份以加速載入；當機後待替換或排隊中的訊息，重試時如實標為已放棄；恢復的工作階段結束後能正常退出，不再因先前的工具拒絕紀錄卡死；提醒檢查已作出決定後，即使被 Stop 或 PreToolUse 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）阻擋，也不再重複執行。
body.en:
When developing Muse applications in Python, missing core dependencies after installation often leaves developers unsure where to look. Now, running `pip install muse-code-sdk` automatically installs the companion wire-types package, allowing a fresh environment to execute `import muse_code`. SDK applications also correctly identify a new turn started by Replace as the running turn (`activeTurn`). ⟦Unboxing flat-pack furniture previously required hunting down missing parts, but tools and screws now arrive bundled together, while repetitive assembly instructions are condensed into a single shared guide that keeps packages lighter and setups faster.⟧

Long sessions store repeated setup blocks once to speed up loading. Messages awaiting replacement or queued during a crash are accurately marked as abandoned when retried. Resumed sessions exit normally after completing their run instead of hanging on earlier tool rejection records. Once a reminder check has reached a decision, it no longer runs repeatedly even when blocked by a Stop or PreToolUse hook (a small program triggered by specific events).

items.original:
After a crash, a message you sent to replace Muse's current reply, or one Muse showed as queued while it was busy, is no longer treated as done: retrying it now says it was abandoned instead of claiming it already ran
Apps built on the Muse SDKs now see the new turn a Replace starts as the running turn (the session snapshot's `activeTurn`) instead of no running turn
`pip install muse-code-sdk` now also installs its companion wire-types package, so `import muse_code` works in a fresh Python environment
Reminder checks no longer repeat after their decision when a Stop or PreToolUse hook blocks them
Resumed sessions exit after the run finishes instead of hanging when an earlier denied tool approval predates the session's latest checkpoint
Long sessions store repeated setup blocks once, so logs stay small and resume loads faster

title.zh-TW: 內建 `web3d` skill，幫你做單檔 3D 網頁和瀏覽器小遊戲
title.en: Built-in `web3d` skill builds single-file 3D web pages and browser games

body.zh-TW: 想做一個能在瀏覽器裡轉動的 3D 產品展示頁，或一款小遊戲，現在可以直接交給 Muse。內建的 `web3d` skill（教 AI 照固定步驟做某類工作的說明書）會引導它做出單檔的 3D 網頁或瀏覽器遊戲，交件前先開瀏覽器檢查。動工前，它會先規劃每個部分的形狀、周遭環境和材質；第一版能跑之後，再派一個全新的測試子代理實際玩一遍、寫下批評，批評沒處理完不准交件，審查輪數也有時間上限。⟦餐廳出菜前先請另一位廚師試吃挑毛病，挑出的問題改完才端上桌，但試吃不會無限輪下去。⟧你說「停」，或只要它打開頁面時，它會立刻停止檢查。
body.en: Want a 3D product page you can spin in the browser, or a small game? You can now hand it straight to Muse. The built-in `web3d` skill (a playbook that teaches the AI fixed steps for one kind of job) guides it in building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff. Before building, it plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials; after the first working build, a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds. ⟦A kitchen has a second chef taste each dish and point out flaws before it goes out, but the tasting does not go on forever.⟧ When you say stop, or just ask it to open the page, it stops checking right away.

items.original:
Added a built-in `web3d` skill that guides building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff
The built-in `web3d` skill now plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials before building, and after the first working build a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds
The built-in `web3d` skill now stops checking a page as soon as you say stop or ask it to just open the page

title.zh-TW: 新增 `/game-3d-visuals`，`/blender` 也能做一般 3D 工作
title.en: New `/game-3d-visuals`, and `/blender` takes on general 3D work

body.zh-TW: 手上有幾張參考圖，想做出長得一樣的 3D 模型或遊戲畫面？新的 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令會依參考圖和一份視覺規格驅動 3D 模型與遊戲製作，並反覆比對渲染圖（電腦算出來的成品畫面）和參考圖，直到合格。`/blender` 則擴大到 Blender 裡的一般 3D 工作：建模、照一張圖重建場景、動畫和大型環境都能做，附帶的輔助腳本在 Blender 4 和 5 都能用。它也能拿渲染圖跟參考圖對量，逐格檢查動畫有沒有突然跳動、物體下沉或跑出鏡頭。折射的反彈次數也保留得更多，疊在一起的玻璃不會再渲染得那麼暗。
body.en: Have a few reference images and want a 3D model or game scene that matches them? The new `/game-3d-visuals` command drives 3D models and games from reference images and a visual spec, comparing each render (the finished image the computer calculates) against the references until it passes. `/blender` now covers general 3D work in Blender: object modeling, recreating a scene from an image, animation and large environments, with helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5. It can also measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot. It keeps more refraction bounces too, so stacked glass renders less dark.

items.original:
Added `/game-3d-visuals` to drive 3D models and games from reference images, a visual spec, and a render-vs-reference acceptance loop
`/blender` now handles general 3D work in Blender, including object modeling, scene recreation from an image, animation and large environments, and ships helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5
`/blender` can now measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot, and keeps more refraction bounces so stacked glass renders less dark

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定新增 `session/leave`，可把對話交給另一台主機
title.en: The session protocol adds `session/leave` to hand a session to another host

body.zh-TW: 自己寫用戶端、透過工作階段協定（讓其他程式操控 Muse 對話的溝通規則）接 Muse 的開發者，現在多了 `session/leave`。用戶端可以把一個已載入的工作階段交給另一台主機，原本這台主機和上面其他工作階段照常運作。⟦客服把一通電話轉給另一個部門，自己這條線和其他來電都不受影響，跟這個動作一模一樣。⟧另一個修正也跟搬動工作階段有關：主機把閒置的分支卸載後，或主機重新啟動後，用同一個指令重試 `session/fork`，以前會回內部錯誤，現在會拿回那個分支和它的歷史紀錄。
body.en: Developers who write their own clients on top of the session protocol (the rules other programs use to drive Muse conversations) now get `session/leave`. A client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running. ⟦A support agent transfers one call to another department while their own line and every other caller carry on untouched.⟧ A related fix: retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, used to return an internal error; it now returns that fork and its history.

items.original:
Added `session/leave` to the session protocol, so a client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running
Retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, now returns that fork and its history instead of an internal error

title.zh-TW: SDK 能回答 agent 的提問，續接時也收得到待核准的請求
title.en: The SDKs can answer the agent's questions and catch pending approvals on resume

body.zh-TW: 用 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 把 Muse 嵌進自己程式的人，可能遇過 agent 問了問題，程式卻沒辦法回答。現在 TypeScript 用 `Session.answerUserInput`、Python 用 `Session.answer_user_input` 就能回答，續接工作階段時還沒答的問題也行。續接時也能傳入核准處理器和核准失敗觀察器，續接當下還在等核准的請求會送到處理器，失敗則通知觀察器。SDK 以前會對不接受意見的核准選項送出意見，讓核准一直卡著；現在改回報新的 `feedbackNotAccepted` 失敗類型，列出哪些選項收意見，並改選提供的拒絕或中止選項讓這一輪繼續。程式若逐一處理每種 `ApprovalFailure`，要補上這個新類型。
body.en: If you embed Muse in your own program with the TypeScript or Python SDK, you may have had the agent ask a question your code could not answer. Now TypeScript can answer with `Session.answerUserInput` and Python with `Session.answer_user_input`, including a question still open when a session is resumed. When resuming, you can also pass an approval handler and an approval-failure observer, so an approval still pending at resume reaches the handler and any failure reaches the observer. The SDKs used to send feedback on an approval choice that does not accept it, which left the approval open; they now report the new `feedbackNotAccepted` failure kind, listing the choices that accept feedback, and answer with the offered deny or abort choice so the turn goes on. Code that handles every `ApprovalFailure` kind needs a case for it.

items.original:
The TypeScript and Python SDKs can answer the agent's questions with `Session.answerUserInput` and `Session.answer_user_input`, including a question still open when a session is resumed
The TypeScript and Python SDKs accept an approval handler and an approval-failure observer when resuming a session, so an approval still pending at resume reaches the handler and any failure reaches the observer
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer send feedback on an approval choice that does not accept it, which left the approval open; they report the new `feedbackNotAccepted` failure kind (listing the choices that accept feedback) and answer with the offered deny or abort choice so the turn goes on, and code that handles every `ApprovalFailure` kind needs a case for it

title.zh-TW: SDK 補收漏掉的事件時，不再提早收工
title.en: The SDKs no longer stop filling event gaps too early

body.zh-TW: SDK 和 Muse 之間的事件偶爾會漏送，這時 SDK 要把缺口補齊。以前較早的缺口通知如果在較晚那則之後又送到一次，Python 和 TypeScript SDK 會提早停止補缺口，甚至回報工作階段已是最新，其實還少了事件。⟦郵差把上週的補寄通知晚於本週的送來，以前你就以為信都到齊、不再等了，現在你認得出那是舊通知，直接丟掉。⟧現在重複的舊通知，Python 會回 `IgnoredStaleFrame`，TypeScript 會回 `ignoredStaleFrame`。TypeScript 的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 也多了 `view/gap`，程式若逐一比對它的每個值，要補一個新分支。
body.en: Events between the SDK and Muse sometimes go missing, and the SDK then has to fill the gap. When an earlier gap notice was redelivered after a later one, the Python and TypeScript SDKs used to stop filling the gap early, or even report the session current while events were still missing. ⟦When last week's redelivery notice arrived after this week's, you used to assume all the mail was in and stop waiting; now you recognize it as an old notice and toss it.⟧ The repeated notice now returns `IgnoredStaleFrame` in Python and `ignoredStaleFrame` in TypeScript. TypeScript's `StaleDroppableMethod` also gains `view/gap`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case.

items.original:
The Python SDK no longer stops filling a delivery gap early, or reports the session current with events missing, when an earlier gap notice is redelivered after a later one; the repeat now returns `IgnoredStaleFrame`
The TypeScript SDK no longer stops filling a delivery gap early, or reports the session current with events missing, when an earlier gap notice is redelivered after a later one; the repeat now returns `ignoredStaleFrame`, and `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `view/gap`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case

title.zh-TW: agent 外掛能附 MCP 伺服器，用 `muse mcp login` 登入
title.en: Agent plugins can bring MCP servers with `muse mcp login` sign-in

body.zh-TW: 想裝一個外掛，順便把它要用的外部服務也接好？agent 外掛現在可以附帶 MCP 伺服器（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定），每個伺服器各自審核，並用 `muse mcp login` 登入。Windows 上，外掛的 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）若用 `/bin/bash` 這類根目錄路徑啟動程式，以前安裝會失敗並顯示「plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root」，現在裝得起來。審核過的 skill 在登入後重新啟用時，授權也不會掉：審核過的 `allowed-tools` 保留預先核准，不會在未登入啟動之後退回跳出核准視窗。
body.en: Want a plugin to set up the outside services it needs at install time? Agent plugins can now supply MCP servers (the protocol that connects AI to external tools), each with its own review and `muse mcp login` sign-in. On Windows, plugins whose hooks (small programs triggered automatically at certain moments) start a program by a rooted path such as `/bin/bash` used to fail to install with "plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root"; they now install. A reviewed skill also keeps its grant when it is re-armed after login: reviewed `allowed-tools` keep their preapproval instead of falling back to an approval prompt after a logged-out start.

items.original:
Agent plugins can supply MCP servers with per-server review and `muse mcp login` sign-in
On Windows, plugins whose hooks start a program by a rooted path such as `/bin/bash` now install instead of failing with "plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root"
A reviewed skill's invocation-grant resolver now survives the post-login re-arm, so reviewed `allowed-tools` keep their preapproval instead of falling back to an approval prompt after a logged-out start

title.zh-TW: `muse exec --json` 列出每次執行的 token 用量，`/usage` 也算進背景工作
title.en: `muse exec --json` reports token usage per run, and `/usage` counts background work

body.zh-TW: 用腳本跑 Muse、想知道每次花了多少，現在不用自己估。`muse exec --json` 會在每次執行結束前印一行 `run.usage`，列出這次各模型用了多少 token（AI 計算用量的單位），以及你訂閱方案的額度。`/usage` 的總數也把背景工作算進去了，並在另一列 Observers 單獨列出。⟦水費帳單以前只算客廳的水龍頭，現在連後院自動灑水也計入，還分開列一行讓你看清楚。⟧
body.en: If you run Muse from scripts and want to know what each run cost, you no longer have to guess. `muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage (the unit AI usage is measured in) per model and your subscription allowance. `/usage` totals now include background work too, broken out in a separate Observers row. ⟦A water bill that used to count only the kitchen tap now includes the backyard sprinklers, listed on their own line so you can see them.⟧

items.original:
`muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage per model and your subscription allowance
`/usage` totals now include background work and break it out in a separate Observers row

title.zh-TW: `muse serve` 可用環境設定調容量，當機後重開的對話不再卡住
title.en: `muse serve` takes capacity settings, and chats reopened after a crash no longer look stuck

body.zh-TW: 把 Muse 架成服務給多個程式共用的話，`muse serve` 現在讀三個環境設定，分別控制工作執行緒、指令受理容量和最多載入幾個工作階段；值寫錯會報出來，並改用正式環境的值。服務執行中你才登入、帳號卻還沒完成初始設定時，回合以前只叫你再登入一次，現在會說明該怎麼做。當機把工作階段紀錄的結尾截掉後，重開的對話以前看起來像卡住，現在歷史、新回合和核准請求都會正常顯示。讀長訊息、工作流程子任務的提示或原始網頁搜尋結果的下一頁時，如果沒有新存檔，也不再把整段對話重讀一遍。
body.en: If you run Muse as a service shared by several programs, `muse serve` now reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used. When you log in while it is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns used to just ask you to log in again; they now say what to do. A chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log used to look stuck; its history, new turns and approval requests now show again. Reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved.

items.original:
`muse serve` reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity, and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used
When you log in while `muse serve` is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again
A `muse serve` chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log now shows its history, new turns and approval requests again, instead of looking stuck
In `muse serve`, reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved

title.zh-TW: 支援 OSC 7501 的終端機，看得到 Muse 每一項背景工作
title.en: Terminals with OSC 7501 show every piece of background work Muse is running

body.zh-TW: Muse 同時在背景跑好幾件事時，你很難知道它到底在忙什麼，又是哪一件在等你。支援程式狀態回報（OSC 7501）的終端機，現在會顯示工作階段正在跑的每個監控和背景終端機。工作流程、子代理和背景的後續回合也會一一列出，還會標出哪一個正在等你回應。⟦機場看板以前只掛一班飛機，現在每班的狀態都上板，哪一班在等你登機一眼就看到。⟧
body.en: When Muse runs several things in the background, it is hard to tell what it is busy with and which one is waiting on you. Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now show each monitor and background terminal a session is running. Each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn is listed too, along with which one is waiting for you. ⟦An airport board that used to show just one flight now lists every flight's status, so you spot the one waiting for you to board at a glance.⟧

items.original:
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each monitor and background terminal a session is running
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn a session is running, and which one is waiting for you

title.zh-TW: 網路核准預設選「這次不再問」，自動審查不再把本機請求全丟給你
title.en: Network approvals default to "don't ask again", and auto-review stops handing you every local request

body.zh-TW: Muse 要連某個網址時會先問你，以前同一個目的地可能一問再問。現在網路核准提示預設停在「Yes, don't ask again this session」，只針對那個主機和連接埠，直接按 Enter，同一個目的地就不會再問。自動審查（Auto-review）以前看到連往 `localhost` 或 `127.0.0.1` 的請求，光憑位址或連接埠就整個交給你決定，現在會像其他動作一樣自己審。續接一個明確關掉審查員的 Auto-review 工作階段時，以前會被拒絕，現在照當時記下的人工設定繼續。
body.en: Muse asks before connecting to an address, and the same destination could ask again and again. Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again. Auto-review used to hand you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it now reviews them like any other action. Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly turned off used to be refused; it now proceeds under the recorded human override.

items.original:
Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again
Auto-review no longer hands you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it reviews them like any other action
Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly off now proceeds under the recorded human override instead of refusing, matching gate-off

title.zh-TW: 工作流程當機後續跑，不再重跑已完成的子代理
title.en: Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns finished subagents

body.zh-TW: 長時間的工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動執行的機制）跑到一半當機，最怕續跑時從頭再來。現在續跑時，在不同時間點已完成的平行子代理不會再重跑，也不會警告存下的復原狀態不可信，除非當機時還有更早啟動的子代理在跑。續跑被拒或啟動後失敗，現在會記下最終結果，用戶端不會一直顯示工作流程還開著。工作流程啟動後的部分歷史遺失、讀不到工作階段的歷史檔，或缺的部分包含工作流程怎麼啟動的紀錄時，續跑都會停下來說明原因，請你重跑那段工作，不再硬接著跑、從頭重跑或只丟一個沒頭沒尾的錯誤。
body.en: When a long Workflow (a mechanism that chains subtasks to run automatically) crashes halfway, the worst outcome is starting over on resume. Resuming now no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash. A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its final outcome, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open. When part of the saved history written after the Workflow started is missing, when Muse cannot read the session's history file, or when the missing part includes how the Workflow started, resuming now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of pressing on, rerunning from the start or failing with a bare error.

items.original:
Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash
A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its terminal reconciliation, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open until the host exits
When part of a session's saved history written after a Workflow started is missing, resuming that Workflow now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of continuing it
When Muse can't read a session's saved history file, resuming a Workflow from that session now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of re-running the Workflow from the start
When the missing part of a session's saved history includes the record of how a Workflow started, resuming that Workflow now also stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of failing with a bare error

title.zh-TW: 工作流程的子代理指定模型時不再被誤拒
title.en: Workflow subagents that name a model are no longer wrongly refused

body.zh-TW: 明明指名的就是正在用的模型，子代理卻不肯開工，讓人摸不著頭緒。現在工作流程裡的子代理指名的若正是工作階段在用的模型，就算它在模型清單裡被隱藏或不見，也照常執行，跟不指定模型一樣。在舊版開始的工作階段裡，只要 `/model` 對你的供應商列出該模型一次，指名它的子代理也能執行。工作流程裡的代理讀取存下的結果時，會拿到來源和欄位標籤；摘要清單省略較早的結果時，就算完整結果還在，也會收到通知。ParallelGroup 拒絕執行時，錯誤訊息會點名 members 參數和 .defer 改法，不再只給籠統的資料錯誤或內部代理編號。
body.en: Naming a model for a subagent in a Workflow could get refused for no clear reason. A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out. In sessions first started on an older version, a subagent that names a model now runs when `/model` lists that model once for your provider. Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results, and get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available. ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier.

items.original:
Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results
ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier
A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out
Workflow agents now get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available
A Workflow subagent that names a model now runs in sessions first started on an older version, when `/model` lists that model once for your provider, instead of being refused

title.zh-TW: Muse 只說下一步卻沒動手時，會被催著繼續做
title.en: When Muse only announces its next step, it is nudged to keep going

body.zh-TW: 請 Muse 做事，它回一句「接下來我會……」就停了，你只好再打一次「繼續」。現在模型只交代下一步、沒有呼叫任何工具時，agent 會請它接著做，每次執行最多催兩次。子代理因設定的模型不能用而改用工作階段模型時，啟動它的 agent 仍會知道實際跑的是哪個模型。Muse 當機重啟後，agent 直接啟動、還沒開始跑的子代理不會自己再啟動一次，而是給上層一個「結果不明」，讓它檢查後決定要不要重開。你回答問題或傳新訊息前備好的 skill 提醒，現在會被丟掉，Muse 不會照著已經過時的建議行動；背景任務完成時，也不再重問還沒答的問題。
body.en: You ask Muse to do something, it replies "next I will…" and stops, and you have to type "continue" again. Now, when the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on, up to twice per run. When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran. After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start it again if still needed. A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent another message is now dropped, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled, and the agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes.

items.original:
After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly (not from a workflow) that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start the subagent again if still needed
When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran
When the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on (up to twice per run) instead of ending the turn there
A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent it another message is now dropped instead of reaching Muse as current advice, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled
Agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes

title.zh-TW: 壓縮時檢查點沒存成，下一回合會補存，長對話重開又快了
title.en: Missed checkpoints during compaction are saved next turn, so long sessions reopen fast again

body.zh-TW: 很長的工作階段要重新打開，靠的是檢查點（記錄對話進度的存檔）才能快速接上。壓縮對話時如果檢查點沒存成，下一回合現在會補存，而且不再多做一次摘要，重開長對話又快了。側邊對話在壓縮時正在跑工具，或取消的工作流程工具存不下來時，那次壓縮現在也會存好續接用的檢查點。磁碟滿或寫入失敗排除後，下一個檢查點會正常儲存，不再又跳過一次。壓縮檢查點失敗又無法回復時，工作階段以前每一步都重新摘要同一段歷史，現在會保留每份摘要繼續往下。長工作階段也會在檢查點修剪已涵蓋的紀錄，不再無限長大。
body.en: Reopening a long session quickly depends on checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress). When a checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again. Compactions that happen while a side chat is mid-tool, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved, now save their resume checkpoint too. After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more. A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back used to re-summarize the same history on every step; it now keeps each summary and continues. Long sessions also trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound.

items.original:
When a context checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again
Resuming a session stays fast after a side chat was mid-tool during a compaction, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved; those compactions now save their resume checkpoint
Long sessions trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound
After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next context checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more
A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back no longer re-summarizes the same history on every step; it keeps each compacted summary and continues

title.zh-TW: 有背景任務或分支對話時，檢查點也照常儲存
title.en: Checkpoints keep saving alongside background tasks and branched chats

body.zh-TW: Muse 多線並行時，記錄對話進度的檢查點（重開對話時用來快速接上的存檔）以前常被默默漏存。工具執行中有監控或背景任務回報時，這一回合剩下的檢查點現在不再被跳過。在來源對話同一次開啟裡打開的分支、倒回或側邊對話，現在會存自己的檢查點，不必等到 app 重開。重開對話後才完成的背景任務，就算啟動它的回合無法還原，也不再擋住壓縮存檢查點。背景任務還在跑時重開已存的對話，任務完成後，檢查點和任務結果都會照常記錄下來。
body.en: With background tasks, forks or side chats open, checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress) used to get skipped quietly. Checkpoints are no longer skipped for the rest of a turn when a monitor or background task reports in while tools are running. A forked, rewound or side chat opened in the same app run as its source now saves its checkpoints instead of skipping them until the app restarts. A background task that finishes after you reopen a chat no longer stops compaction from saving checkpoints when the turn that started it could not be restored. Reopening a saved chat while a task it started is still running no longer stops the checkpoint, or the task's result, from being recorded when that task finishes.

items.original:
Context checkpoints are no longer skipped for the rest of a turn when a monitor or background task reports in while tools are running
A forked, rewound or side chat opened in the same app run as its source now saves its context checkpoints, instead of skipping them until the app restarts
A background task that finishes after you reopen a chat no longer stops compaction from saving checkpoints when the turn that started it could not be restored
Reopening a saved chat while a background task it started is still running no longer stops compaction from saving its checkpoint, or the task's result from being recorded, when that task finishes

title.zh-TW: `/compact` 在續接和分支的對話裡都能正常用
title.en: `/compact` works properly in resumed and forked chats

body.zh-TW: 手動打 `/compact` 壓縮對話，卻看不出到底成功沒有？續接工作階段後，`/compact` 現在會在對話紀錄裡顯示「◆ Context compacted」結果列，不再默默毫無變化。續接的分支對話裡，`/compact` 可以重複使用。正在看背景結果時打 `/compact`，現在壓縮的是最新的主要執行，不是那份背景結果。重開的對話裡，如果子代理的結果剛好在先前某次壓縮前才存進去，以前之後每次壓縮都會失敗，現在不會。agent 工作時你先打好的排隊輸入，會在回合結束後的壓縮做完就執行，不再停在閒置的提示前空等。
body.en: Type `/compact` and cannot tell whether it worked? After resuming a session, `/compact` now shows its `◆ Context compacted` outcome row in the transcript instead of silently leaving it unchanged. In resumed forked conversations, `/compact` works repeatedly. Issued while viewing a background delivery, `/compact` now compacts the newest top-level run instead of the delivery run. A reopened chat no longer fails every compaction when a subagent delivery was saved late, just before an earlier compaction. Input you queued while the agent was working now runs after a post-turn compaction instead of waiting at an idle prompt.

items.original:
Queued input typed while the agent was working now runs after a post-turn context compaction instead of waiting at an idle prompt
After resuming a session, `/compact` now shows its `◆ Context compacted` outcome row in the transcript instead of silently leaving the transcript unchanged
A reopened chat no longer fails every compaction when a subagent delivery was saved late, just before an earlier compaction
`/compact` works repeatedly in resumed forked conversations
/compact issued while viewing a background delivery now compacts the newest top-level run instead of the delivery run

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿造成的寫入失敗，不再讓對話打不開
title.en: Write failures from a full disk no longer lock you out of a chat

body.zh-TW: 磁碟滿了是常見的意外，但不該讓整段對話報銷。工具結果因磁碟滿等原因寫不進去的對話，現在不必重開 app 就能再打開。工具呼叫寫不進去、結果卻寫進去的對話，重開後也打得開，只把那一回合擱置，Muse 會說明一次。記錄工作流程啟動結果時遇到磁碟錯誤，對話以前會一直停止存檔到重開為止，現在不會。用圖片倒回所建立的對話，在自動保留歷史的檢查點之後，倒回更早的回合也不再失敗。
body.en: A full disk is a common mishap, but it should not wreck a whole conversation. A saved chat whose tool result could not be written to disk, for example on a full disk, now opens again without a restart. A chat whose tool call could not be written while its result was written now opens after a restart; only that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once. A disk error while recording a workflow launch result no longer stops the chat from saving until restart. In a conversation created by rewinding with an image, rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after an automatic history-preserving checkpoint.

items.original:
A chat no longer stops saving until restart after a disk error while recording a workflow launch result
A saved chat whose tool result could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) now opens again without a restart
Rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after an automatic history-preserving checkpoint in a conversation created by rewinding with an image
A chat whose tool call could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) while its result was written now opens again after a restart; only that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 續接工作階段時，歷史、推理和背景狀態都會保留
title.en: Resumed sessions keep their history, reasoning and background status

body.zh-TW: 隔天回來想接著昨天的工作做，最怕打開是空的或少了一截。自動更新時還開著的工作階段，現在續接會帶回歷史，不再空空如也。有待處理背景結果的對話，續接時不再冒出不必要的上下文上限錯誤。檢查點修剪後續接，那些在新一代沒提供工具的 MCP 伺服器（連接外部工具的服務），工具身分綁定不會再弄丟。透過 `muse serve` 續接最早在 `muse` 供應商標籤下記錄、又用了記錄事件外掛的對話，先前的推理會保留，不再被當成別家的丟掉。重開側邊對話或分支後，背景工作狀態仍看得到；續接時也會自動取好名字。
body.en: Coming back the next day to pick up where you left off, the worst surprise is an empty or truncated session. A session left running through an auto-update now resumes with its history instead of coming back empty. Conversations with pending background results resume without unnecessary context limit errors.
